 18	pub fn detect_format(data : Bytes) -> @types.ImageFormat {
 19	  let len = data.length()
 20	  if len < 2 {
 21	    return @types.ImageFormat::Unknown
 22	  }
 23	  // PNG: 8字节签名
 24	  if len >= 8 &&
 25	    data[0].to_int() == 0x89 &&
 26	    data[1].to_int() == 0x50 &&
 27	    data[2].to_int() == 0x4E &&
 28	    data[3].to_int() == 0x47 &&
 29	    data[4].to_int() == 0x0D &&
 30	    data[5].to_int() == 0x0A &&
 31	    data[6].to_int() == 0x1A &&
 32	    data[7].to_int() == 0x0A {
 33	    return @types.ImageFormat::Png
 34	  }
 35	  // JPEG: SOI marker
 36	  if data[0].to_int() == 0xFF && data[1].to_int() == 0xD8 {
 37	    return @types.ImageFormat::Jpeg
 38	  }
 39	  // BMP: "BM"
 40	  if data[0].to_int() == 0x42 && data[1].to_int() == 0x4D {
 41	    return @types.ImageFormat::Bmp
 42	  }
 43	  // QOI: "qoif"
 44	  if len >= 4 &&
 45	    data[0].to_int() == 0x71 &&
 46	    data[1].to_int() == 0x6F &&
 47	    data[2].to_int() == 0x69 &&
 48	    data[3].to_int() == 0x66 {
 49	    return @types.ImageFormat::Qoi
 50	  }
 51	  // PNM: "P5"/"P6"
 52	  if data[0].to_int() == 0x50 &&
 53	    data[1].to_int() >= 0x35 &&
 54	    data[1].to_int() <= 0x36 {
 55	    return @types.ImageFormat::Pnm
 56	  }
 57	  // PSD: "8BPS"
 58	  if len >= 4 &&
 59	    data[0].to_int() == 0x38 &&
 60	    data[1].to_int() == 0x42 &&
 61	    data[2].to_int() == 0x50 &&
 62	    data[3].to_int() == 0x53 {
 63	    return @types.ImageFormat::Psd
 64	  }
 65	  // GIF: "GIF87a" or "GIF89a"
 66	  if len >= 6 &&
 67	    data[0].to_int() == 0x47 &&
 68	    data[1].to_int() == 0x49 &&
 69	    data[2].to_int() == 0x46 {
 70	    return @types.ImageFormat::Gif
 71	  }
 72	  // HDR: #?RADIANCE
 73	  if len >= 10 &&
 74	    data[0].to_int() == 0x23 &&
 75	    data[1].to_int() == 0x3F &&
 76	    data[2].to_int() == 0x52 {
 77	    return @types.ImageFormat::Hdr
 78	  }
 79	  // WebP: RIFF....WEBP
 80	  if len >= 12 &&
 81	    data[0].to_int() == 0x52 &&
 82	    data[1].to_int() == 0x49 &&
 83	    data[2].to_int() == 0x46 &&
 84	    data[3].to_int() == 0x46 &&
 85	    data[8].to_int() == 0x57 &&
 86	    data[9].to_int() == 0x45 &&
 87	    data[10].to_int() == 0x42 &&
 88	    data[11].to_int() == 0x50 {
 89	    return @types.ImageFormat::Webp
 90	  }
 91	  // ICNS: 前4字节 "icns"
 92	  if len >= 4 &&
 93	    data[0].to_int() == 0x69 &&
 94	    data[1].to_int() == 0x63 &&
 95	    data[2].to_int() == 0x6E &&
 96	    data[3].to_int() == 0x73 {
 97	    return @types.ImageFormat::Icns
 98	  }
 99	  // TIFF: 字节序标记 (II=0x4949 LE, MM=0x4D4D BE) + magic 42 (offset 2-3)
100	  if (data[0].to_int() == 0x49 && data[1].to_int() == 0x49) ||
101	    (data[0].to_int() == 0x4D && data[1].to_int() == 0x4D) {
102	    if len >= 4 &&
103	      (
104	        (data[2].to_int() == 0x2A && data[3].to_int() == 0x00) ||
105	        (data[2].to_int() == 0x00 && data[3].to_int() == 0x2A)
106	      ) {
107	      return @types.ImageFormat::Tiff
108	    }
109	  }
110	  // ICO/CUR: 00 00 XX 00 + 图像数量 (≥1) + 目录条目
111	  // XX = 01 (ICO) 或 02 (CUR)，总长度至少 22 字节（6 头 + 16 目录条目）
112	  if len >= 22 &&
113	    data[0].to_int() == 0x00 &&

 74	pub fn read_exif_from_bytes(data : Bytes) -> ExifInfo? {
 75	  let len = data.length()
 76	  if len < 4 || data[0].to_int() != 0xFF || data[1].to_int() != 0xD8 {
 77	    return None
 78	  }
 79	  // 查找 APP1 marker (0xFF 0xE1)
 80	  let mut pos = 2
 81	  let mut exif_start = -1
 82	  let mut exif_len = 0
 83	  while pos < len - 1 {
 84	    if data[pos].to_int() == 0xFF && data[pos + 1].to_int() == 0xE1 {
 85	      exif_len = read_u16_be(data, pos + 2) - 2
 86	      exif_start = pos + 4
 87	      break
 88	    }
 89	    if data[pos].to_int() == 0xFF {
 90	      let marker = data[pos + 1].to_int()
 91	      if marker == 0xDA || marker == 0xD9 {
 92	        break
 93	      }
 94	      let seg_len = read_u16_be(data, pos + 2)
 95	      pos += 2 + seg_len
 96	    } else {

 98	    }

104	  if exif_len < 6 ||
105	    data[exif_start].to_int() != 0x45 ||
106	    data[exif_start + 1].to_int() != 0x78 ||

510	pub fn detect_speech_activity(
511	  audio : AudioData,
512	  threshold : Double,
513	) -> VADResult {
514	  let segments : Array[Array[Double]] = []
515	  let mut speech_duration = 0.0
516	  let mut in_speech = false
517	  let mut segment_start = 0.0
518	
519	  let frame_duration = 512.0 / audio.sample_rate.to_double()
520	  let num_frames = audio.num_samples / 512
521	
522	  for frame_idx in 0..<num_frames {
523	    // 计算帧能量
524	    let mut energy = 0.0
525	    let start_sample = frame_idx * 512
526	    let end_sample = if start_sample + 512 < audio.num_samples {
527	      start_sample + 512
528	    } else {
529	      audio.num_samples	<-- UNCOVERED
530	    }
531	
532	    for i in start_sample..<end_sample {
533	      energy += audio.samples[i] * audio.samples[i]
534	    }
535	    energy /= (end_sample - start_sample).to_double()
536	
537	    let is_speech = energy > threshold
538	
539	    if is_speech && !in_speech {
540	      segment_start = frame_idx.to_double() * frame_duration
541	      in_speech = true
542	    } else if !is_speech && in_speech {
543	      let segment_end = frame_idx.to_double() * frame_duration	<-- UNCOVERED
544	      let segment : Array[Double] = []
545	      segment.push(segment_start)	<-- UNCOVERED
546	      segment.push(segment_end)
547	      segments.push(segment)
548	      speech_duration += segment_end - segment_start
549	      in_speech = false
550	    }
551	  }
552	
553	  if in_speech {
554	    let segment_end = num_frames.to_double() * frame_duration
555	    let segment : Array[Double] = []
556	    segment.push(segment_start)
557	    segment.push(segment_end)
558	    segments.push(segment)
559	    speech_duration += segment_end - segment_start
560	  }
561	
562	  let silence_duration = audio.duration_s - speech_duration
563	  let speech_ratio = if audio.duration_s > 0.0 {
564	    speech_duration / audio.duration_s
565	  } else {
566	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
567	  }
568	
569	  VADResult::{
570	    audio,
571	    speech_segments: segments,
572	    num_segments: segments.length(),
573	    speech_duration,
574	    silence_duration,
575	    speech_ratio,
576	    threshold,
577	  }

181	fn decode_ean13_from_binary(

286	fn decode_ean13_digit(
287	  binary : Array[Int],
288	  start : Int,

296	    if pos < binary.length() {

308	      }
309	    }
310	    // 尝试 G 码（偶数）
311	    for d in 0..<10 {
312	      if modules == ean13_g_codes[d] {	<-- UNCOVERED
313	        return (d, 1) // 1 = G码（偶数）
314	      }
315	    }
316	  } else {

318	    for d in 0..<10 {	<-- UNCOVERED
319	      if modules == ean13_r_codes[d] {
320	        return (d, 0)
321	      }
322	    }
323	  }
324	  (-1, 0)

346	fn validate_ean13_checksum(barcode : String) -> Bool {
347	  if barcode.length() != 13 {	<-- UNCOVERED
348	    return false
349	  }

353	    if i % 2 == 0 {

254	fn apply_qr_mask(

272	        5 => row * col % 2 + row * col % 3 == 0
273	        6 => (row * col % 2 + row * col % 3) % 2 == 0
274	        7 => ((row + col) % 2 + row * col % 3) % 2 == 0

248	    )

251	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
252	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
253	      "threshold_otsu: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
254	      expected_size.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
255	      "，实际 " +
256	      img.data.length().to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
257	    )
258	  }
259	  let ch = img.channels
260	  let color_ch = if ch >= 3 { 3 } else { 1 }
261	  let w = img.width
262	  let h = img.height
263	  let n = w * h
264	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n * ch, b'\x00')
265	  for c_idx in 0..<color_ch {
266	    let hist : Array[Int] = Array::make(256, 0)
267	    for i in 0..<n {
268	      hist[img.data[i * ch + c_idx].to_int()] += 1
269	    }
270	    let mut total = 0
271	    let mut sum = 0
272	    for t in 0..<256 {
273	      total += hist[t]
274	      sum += t * hist[t]
275	    }
276	    let mut best_t = 0
277	    let mut best_var = -1.0F
278	    let mut w0 = 0
279	    let mut sum0 = 0
280	    for t in 0..<256 {
281	      w0 += hist[t]
282	      sum0 += t * hist[t]
283	      if w0 == 0 || w0 == total {
284	        continue
285	      }
286	      let w1 = total - w0
287	      let sum1 = sum - sum0
288	      let mean0 = Float::from_int(sum0) / Float::from_int(w0)
289	      let mean1 = Float::from_int(sum1) / Float::from_int(w1)
290	      let var_between = Float::from_int(w0) *
291	        Float::from_int(w1) *
292	        (mean0 - mean1) *
293	        (mean0 - mean1)
294	      if var_between > best_var {
295	        best_var = var_between
296	        best_t = t
297	      }
298	    }
299	    for i in 0..<n {
300	      let v = img.data[i * ch + c_idx].to_int()
301	      out[i * ch + c_idx] = if v > best_t { b'\xFF' } else { b'\x00' }
302	    }
303	  }
304	  if ch == 4 {
305	    for i in 0..<n {
306	      out[i * 4 + 3] = img.data[i * 4 + 3]
307	    }
308	  }
309	  @types.Image::{
310	    width: w,
311	    height: h,
312	    channels: ch,
313	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),

514	pub fn threshold_otsu_f(
515	  img : @types.ImageF,
516	) -> @types.ImageF raise @types.LoadError {
517	  if img.channels != 1 && img.channels != 3 && img.channels != 4 {
518	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
519	      "threshold_otsu_f 仅支持 channels=1/3/4",
520	    )
521	  }
522	  let ch = img.channels
523	  let color_ch = if ch >= 3 { 3 } else { 1 }
524	  let w = img.width
525	  let h = img.height
526	  let n = w * h
527	  let bpp = ch * 4
528	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n * bpp, b'\x00')
529	  for c_idx in 0..<color_ch {
530	    let hist : Array[Int] = Array::make(256, 0)
531	    let src : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
532	    for i in 0..<n {
533	      let v = read_float_le(img.data, i * bpp + c_idx * 4)
534	      src[i] = v
535	      let bin = if v < 0.0F {
536	        0	<-- UNCOVERED
537	      } else if v >= 1.0F {
538	        255	<-- UNCOVERED
539	      } else {
540	        (v * 255.0F + 0.5F).to_int()
541	      }
542	      hist[bin] += 1
543	    }
544	    let mut total = 0
545	    let mut sum = 0
546	    for t in 0..<256 {
547	      total += hist[t]
548	      sum += t * hist[t]
549	    }
550	    let mut best_t = 0
551	    let mut best_var = -1.0F
552	    let mut w0 = 0
553	    let mut sum0 = 0
554	    for t in 0..<256 {
555	      w0 += hist[t]
556	      sum0 += t * hist[t]
557	      if w0 == 0 || w0 == total {
558	        continue
559	      }
560	      let w1 = total - w0
561	      let sum1 = sum - sum0
562	      let mean0 = Float::from_int(sum0) / Float::from_int(w0)
563	      let mean1 = Float::from_int(sum1) / Float::from_int(w1)
564	      let var_between = Float::from_int(w0) *
565	        Float::from_int(w1) *
566	        (mean0 - mean1) *
567	        (mean0 - mean1)
568	      if var_between > best_var {
569	        best_var = var_between
570	        best_t = t
571	      }
572	    }
573	    let threshold_f = Float::from_int(best_t) / 255.0F
574	    for i in 0..<n {
575	      if src[i] > threshold_f {
576	        write_f32_le(out, i * bpp + c_idx * 4, 1.0F)
577	      }
578	    }
579	  }
580	  if ch == 4 {
581	    for i in 0..<n {
582	      let alpha_off = i * bpp + 12
583	      for b in 0..<4 {
584	        out[alpha_off + b] = img.data[alpha_off + b]
585	      }
586	    }
587	  }
588	  @types.ImageF::{
589	    width: w,
590	    height: h,
591	    channels: ch,
592	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),
593	  }
594	}

 56	fn clahe_channel(
 57	  img : @types.Image,
 58	  out : Array[Byte],
 59	  channel : Int,
 60	  ch : Int,
 61	  tile_size : Int,
 62	  clip_limit : Float,
 63	) -> Unit {
 64	  let w = img.width
 65	  let h = img.height
 66	  let n = w * h
 67	  // 预计算 to_int 数组
 68	  let data_int : Array[Int] = Array::make(n * ch, 0)
 69	  for i in 0..<(n * ch) {
 70	    data_int[i] = img.data[i].to_int()
 71	  }
 72	  // 块数
 73	  let ntx = (w + tile_size - 1) / tile_size
 74	  let nty = (h + tile_size - 1) / tile_size
 75	  let n_tiles = ntx * nty
 76	  let luts : Array[Array[Int]] = Array::make(n_tiles, Array::make(256, 0))
 77	  // 计算每块的直方图和 LUT
 78	  for ty in 0..<nty {
 79	    for tx in 0..<ntx {
 80	      let hist : Array[Int] = Array::make(256, 0)
 81	      let x0 = tx * tile_size
 82	      let y0 = ty * tile_size
 83	      let x1 = if x0 + tile_size < w { x0 + tile_size } else { w }
 84	      let y1 = if y0 + tile_size < h { y0 + tile_size } else { h }
 85	      let tile_pixels = (x1 - x0) * (y1 - y0)
 86	      for y in y0..<y1 {
 87	        let row_base = y * w
 88	        for x in x0..<x1 {
 89	          let v = data_int[(row_base + x) * ch + channel]
 90	          hist[v] += 1
 91	        }
 92	      }
 93	      // 裁剪直方图
 94	      let clip_count = (Float::from_int(tile_pixels) * clip_limit / 256.0).to_int()
 95	      let mut excess = 0
 96	      for i in 0..<256 {
 97	        if hist[i] > clip_count {
 98	          excess += hist[i] - clip_count
 99	          hist[i] = clip_count
100	        }
101	      }
102	      // 均匀分配多余的像素
103	      let redistribute = excess / 256
104	      let mut remainder = excess - redistribute * 256
105	      for i in 0..<256 {
106	        hist[i] += redistribute
107	        if remainder > 0 {
108	          hist[i] += 1
109	          remainder -= 1
110	        }
111	      }
112	      // 计算 CDF 并归一化到 0-255
113	      let lut = luts[ty * ntx + tx]
114	      let mut cdf = 0
115	      for i in 0..<256 {
116	        cdf += hist[i]
117	        lut[i] = if tile_pixels > 0 {
118	          clamp_i(cdf * 255 / tile_pixels, 0, 255)
119	        } else {
120	          i	<-- UNCOVERED
121	        }
122	      }
123	    }
124	  }
125	  // 预计算 tile 坐标和权重
126	  let inv_tile_size = 1.0F / Float::from_int(tile_size)
127	  let tx_arr : Array[Int] = Array::make(w, 0)
128	  let wx_arr : Array[Float] = Array::make(w, 0.0F)
129	  for x in 0..<w {
130	    let fx = Float::from_int(x) * inv_tile_size - 0.5F
131	    let t = fx.to_int()
132	    tx_arr[x] = t
133	    wx_arr[x] = fx - Float::from_int(t)
134	  }
135	  let ty_arr : Array[Int] = Array::make(h, 0)
136	  let wy_arr : Array[Float] = Array::make(h, 0.0F)
137	  for y in 0..<h {
138	    let fy = Float::from_int(y) * inv_tile_size - 0.5F
139	    let t = fy.to_int()
140	    ty_arr[y] = t
141	    wy_arr[y] = fy - Float::from_int(t)
142	  }
143	  // 双线性插值应用 LUT
144	  for y in 0..<h {
145	    let ty = ty_arr[y]
146	    let wy = wy_arr[y]
147	    let row_base = y * w
148	    let wy_inv = 1.0F - wy
149	    for x in 0..<w {
150	      let tx = tx_arr[x]
151	      let wx = wx_arr[x]
152	      let v = data_int[(row_base + x) * ch + channel]
153	      // 4 个相邻块
154	      let t00 = tile_clamp(tx, ty, ntx, nty)
155	      let t01 = tile_clamp(tx + 1, ty, ntx, nty)
156	      let t10 = tile_clamp(tx, ty + 1, ntx, nty)
157	      let t11 = tile_clamp(tx + 1, ty + 1, ntx, nty)
158	      let v00 = Float::from_int(luts[t00][v])
159	      let v01 = Float::from_int(luts[t01][v])
160	      let v10 = Float::from_int(luts[t10][v])
161	      let v11 = Float::from_int(luts[t11][v])
162	      let wx_inv = 1.0F - wx
163	      let top = v00 * wx_inv + v01 * wx
164	      let bot = v10 * wx_inv + v11 * wx
165	      let result = clamp_i((top * wy_inv + bot * wy).to_int(), 0, 255)
166	      out[(row_base + x) * ch + channel] = result.to_byte()
167	    }
168	  }
169	}

241	pub fn rgb_to_hsv(
242	  r : Int,
243	  g : Int,
244	  b : Int,
245	) -> (Float, Float, Float) raise @types.LoadError {
246	  // 输入验证
247	  if r < 0 || r > 255 || g < 0 || g > 255 || b < 0 || b > 255 {
248	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
249	      "rgb_to_hsv: r,g,b必须在[0,255]范围内",
250	    )
251	  }
252	  let rf = Float::from_int(r) / 255.0F
253	  let gf = Float::from_int(g) / 255.0F
254	  let bf = Float::from_int(b) / 255.0F
255	  let mx = rf.max(gf).max(bf)
256	  let mn = rf.min(gf).min(bf)
257	  let delta = mx - mn
258	  let v = mx
259	  let s = if mx == 0.0F { 0.0F } else { delta / mx }
260	  let h = if delta == 0.0F {
261	    0.0F
262	  } else if mx == rf {
263	    60.0F * ((gf - bf) / delta)
264	  } else if mx == gf {
265	    60.0F * ((bf - rf) / delta + 2.0F)
266	  } else {
267	    60.0F * ((rf - gf) / delta + 4.0F)
268	  }
269	  let h_norm = if h < 0.0F { h + 360.0F } else { h }
270	  (h_norm, s, v)
271	}

276	pub fn hsv_to_rgb(
277	  h : Float,
278	  s : Float,
279	  v : Float,
280	) -> (Int, Int, Int) raise @types.LoadError {
281	  // 输入验证
282	  if s < 0.0F || s > 1.0F || v < 0.0F || v > 1.0F {
283	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
284	      "hsv_to_rgb: s,v必须在[0,1]范围内",
285	    )
286	  }
287	  let c = v * s
288	  // 归一化 h 到 [0,6)
289	  let mut hp = h / 60.0F
290	  while hp >= 6.0F {
291	    hp = hp - 6.0F
292	  }
293	  while hp < 0.0F {
294	    hp = hp + 6.0F
295	  }
296	  // hp % 2.0
297	  let hp_mod2 = if hp < 2.0F {
298	    hp
299	  } else if hp < 4.0F {
300	    hp - 2.0F
301	  } else {
302	    hp - 4.0F
303	  }
304	  let x = c * (1.0F - (hp_mod2 - 1.0F).abs())
305	  let m = v - c
306	  let (r1, g1, b1) = if hp < 1.0F {
307	    (c, x, 0.0F)
308	  } else if hp < 2.0F {
309	    (x, c, 0.0F)
310	  } else if hp < 3.0F {
311	    (0.0F, c, x)
312	  } else if hp < 4.0F {
313	    (0.0F, x, c)
314	  } else if hp < 5.0F {
315	    (x, 0.0F, c)
316	  } else {
317	    (c, 0.0F, x)
318	  }
319	  (
320	    ((r1 + m) * 255.0F + 0.5F).to_int(),
321	    ((g1 + m) * 255.0F + 0.5F).to_int(),
322	    ((b1 + m) * 255.0F + 0.5F).to_int(),
323	  )
324	}

368	pub fn hsl_to_rgb(
369	  h : Float,
370	  s : Float,
371	  l : Float,
372	) -> (Int, Int, Int) raise @types.LoadError {
373	  // 输入验证
374	  if s < 0.0F || s > 1.0F || l < 0.0F || l > 1.0F {
375	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
376	      "hsl_to_rgb: s,l必须在[0,1]范围内",
377	    )
378	  }
379	  let c = (1.0F - (2.0F * l - 1.0F).abs()) * s
380	  // 归一化 h 到 [0,6)
381	  let mut hp = h / 60.0F
382	  while hp >= 6.0F {
383	    hp = hp - 6.0F
384	  }
385	  while hp < 0.0F {
386	    hp = hp + 6.0F
387	  }
388	  let hp_mod2 = if hp < 2.0F {
389	    hp
390	  } else if hp < 4.0F {
391	    hp - 2.0F
392	  } else {
393	    hp - 4.0F
394	  }
395	  let x = c * (1.0F - (hp_mod2 - 1.0F).abs())
396	  let m = l - c / 2.0F
397	  let (r1, g1, b1) = if hp < 1.0F {
398	    (c, x, 0.0F)
399	  } else if hp < 2.0F {
400	    (x, c, 0.0F)
401	  } else if hp < 3.0F {
402	    (0.0F, c, x)
403	  } else if hp < 4.0F {
404	    (0.0F, x, c)
405	  } else if hp < 5.0F {
406	    (x, 0.0F, c)
407	  } else {
408	    (c, 0.0F, x)
409	  }
410	  (
411	    ((r1 + m) * 255.0F + 0.5F).to_int(),
412	    ((g1 + m) * 255.0F + 0.5F).to_int(),
413	    ((b1 + m) * 255.0F + 0.5F).to_int(),
414	  )
415	}

 9	pub fn dehaze(
10	  img : @types.Image,
11	  patch_size? : Int = 7,
12	  omega? : Float = 0.95F,
13	  t0? : Float = 0.1F,
14	) -> @types.Image raise @types.LoadError {
15	  // 输入验证
16	  if img.width < 0 || img.height < 0 {
17	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("dehaze: 图像尺寸不能为负")	<-- UNCOVERED
18	  }
19	  if img.channels != 3 && img.channels != 4 {
20	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("dehaze 需要 RGB/RGBA 图像")
21	  }

24	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
25	      "dehaze: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
26	      expected_size.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
27	      "，实际 " +
28	      img.data.length().to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
29	    )
30	  }
31	  if patch_size < 1 || patch_size > 30 {
32	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("patch_size 必须在 1..30 之间")
33	  }
34	  if omega <= 0.0F || omega > 1.0F {
35	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("omega 必须在 (0, 1] 之间")
36	  }
37	  if t0 <= 0.0F || t0 > 1.0F {
38	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("t0 必须在 (0, 1] 之间")
39	  }
40	  let ch = img.channels
41	  let w = img.width
42	  let h = img.height
43	  let n = w * h
44	  if n == 0 {
45	    return img
46	  }
47	  // 1. 计算暗通道
48	  let dark_channel = compute_dark_channel(img, w, h, ch, patch_size)
49	  // 2. 估计大气光 A（取暗通道中最亮的 0.1% 像素对应的原图最亮像素）
50	  let a = estimate_atmospheric_light(img, dark_channel, w, h, ch)
51	  let ar = Float::from_int(a[0])
52	  let ag = Float::from_int(a[1])
53	  let ab = Float::from_int(a[2])
54	  // 3. 计算透射率 t = 1 - omega * dark(I/A)
55	  let transmission : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
56	  for i in 0..<n {
57	    transmission[i] = 1.0F - omega * dark_channel[i]
58	    if transmission[i] < t0 {
59	      transmission[i] = t0
60	    }
61	  }
62	  // 4. 恢复无雾图像: J = (I - A) / t + A
63	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n * ch, b'\x00')
64	  for i in 0..<n {
65	    for c in 0..<3 {
66	      let iv = Float::from_int(img.data[i * ch + c].to_int())
67	      let ac = if c == 0 { ar } else if c == 1 { ag } else { ab }
68	      let jv = (iv - ac) / transmission[i] + ac
69	      out[i * ch + c] = jv.to_int().clamp(min=0, max=255).to_byte()
70	    }
71	    if ch == 4 {
72	      out[i * ch + 3] = img.data[i * ch + 3]
73	    }
74	  }
75	  @types.Image::{

77	    height: h,
78	    channels: ch,
79	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),

185	pub fn guided_filter(
186	  img : @types.Image,
187	  input : Array[Float],
188	  radius? : Int = 20,
189	  eps? : Float = 0.001F,
190	) -> Array[Float] raise @types.LoadError {
191	  // 输入验证
192	  if img.width < 0 || img.height < 0 {
193	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
194	      "guided_filter: 图像尺寸不能为负",
195	    )
196	  }
197	  if img.channels != 1 && img.channels != 3 && img.channels != 4 {
198	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
199	      "guided_filter 仅支持 channels=1/3/4",
200	    )
201	  }
202	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
203	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
204	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
205	      "guided_filter: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
206	      expected_size.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
207	      "，实际 " +
208	      img.data.length().to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
209	    )
210	  }
211	  if radius < 1 {
212	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("guided_filter: radius必须>=1")	<-- UNCOVERED
213	  }
214	  if eps <= 0.0F {
215	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("guided_filter: eps必须大于0")	<-- UNCOVERED
216	  }
217	  let w = img.width
218	  let h = img.height
219	  let n = w * h
220	  if n == 0 || input.length() != n {
221	    return []
222	  }
223	  // 转灰度作为引导图
224	  let guide : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
225	  let ch = img.channels
226	  for i in 0..<n {
227	    let v = if ch == 1 {
228	      img.data[i].to_int()
229	    } else {
230	      let r = img.data[i * ch].to_int()
231	      let g = img.data[i * ch + 1].to_int()
232	      let b = img.data[i * ch + 2].to_int()
233	      (r * 299 + g * 587 + b * 114) / 1000
234	    }
235	    guide[i] = Float::from_int(v) / 255.0F
236	  }
237	  // 计算均值
238	  let mean_i = box_filter(guide, w, h, radius)
239	  let mean_p = box_filter(input, w, h, radius)
240	  // 计算 I*P 的均值
241	  let ip : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
242	  for i in 0..<n {
243	    ip[i] = guide[i] * input[i]
244	  }
245	  let mean_ip = box_filter(ip, w, h, radius)
246	  // 协方差
247	  let cov_ip : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
248	  for i in 0..<n {
249	    cov_ip[i] = mean_ip[i] - mean_i[i] * mean_p[i]
250	  }
251	  // I² 的均值
252	  let i_sq : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
253	  for i in 0..<n {
254	    i_sq[i] = guide[i] * guide[i]
255	  }
256	  let mean_i_sq = box_filter(i_sq, w, h, radius)
257	  // 方差
258	  let var_i : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
259	  for i in 0..<n {
260	    var_i[i] = mean_i_sq[i] - mean_i[i] * mean_i[i]
261	  }
262	  // a = cov_ip / (var_i + eps), b = mean_p - a * mean_i
263	  let a : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
264	  let b : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
265	  for i in 0..<n {
266	    a[i] = cov_ip[i] / (var_i[i] + eps)
267	    b[i] = mean_p[i] - a[i] * mean_i[i]
268	  }
269	  let mean_a = box_filter(a, w, h, radius)
270	  let mean_b = box_filter(b, w, h, radius)
271	  // 输出 = mean_a * guide + mean_b
272	  let out : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
273	  for i in 0..<n {
274	    out[i] = mean_a[i] * guide[i] + mean_b[i]
275	  }
276	  out
277	}

 7	pub fn floyd_steinberg(
 8	  img : @types.Image,
 9	  levels : Int,
10	) -> @types.Image raise @types.LoadError {
11	  // 输入验证
12	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
13	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
14	      "floyd_steinberg: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
15	    )
16	  }
17	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
18	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
19	      "floyd_steinberg: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
20	    )
21	  }
22	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
23	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
24	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
25	      "floyd_steinberg: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
26	      expected_size.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
27	      "，实际 " +
28	      img.data.length().to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
29	    )
30	  }
31	  if levels < 2 {
32	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("floyd_steinberg: levels必须>=2")
33	  }
34	  let ch = img.channels
35	  let color_ch = if ch >= 3 { 3 } else { ch }
36	  let w = img.width
37	  let h = img.height
38	  let n = w * h
39	  // 可变像素缓冲
40	  let buf : Array[Int] = Array::make(n * color_ch, 0)
41	  for i in 0..<n {
42	    for c in 0..<color_ch {
43	      buf[i * color_ch + c] = img.data[i * ch + c].to_int()
44	    }
45	  }
46	  let step = 255 / (levels - 1)
47	  let half_step = step / 2
48	  // Floyd-Steinberg 抖动
49	  for y in 0..<h {
50	    for x in 0..<w {
51	      for c in 0..<color_ch {
52	        let idx = (y * w + x) * color_ch + c
53	        let old_val = buf[idx].clamp(min=0, max=255)
54	        let new_val = ((old_val + half_step) / step * step).clamp(
55	          min=0,
56	          max=255,
57	        )
58	        buf[idx] = new_val
59	        let err = old_val - new_val
60	        // 误差扩散：右 7/16, 左下 3/16, 下 5/16, 右下 1/16
61	        if x + 1 < w {
62	          buf[(y * w + x + 1) * color_ch + c] += err * 7 / 16
63	        }
64	        if y + 1 < h {
65	          if x > 0 {
66	            buf[((y + 1) * w + x - 1) * color_ch + c] += err * 3 / 16
67	          }
68	          buf[((y + 1) * w + x) * color_ch + c] += err * 5 / 16
69	          if x + 1 < w {
70	            buf[((y + 1) * w + x + 1) * color_ch + c] += err / 16
71	          }
72	        }
73	      }
74	    }
75	  }
76	  // 输出
77	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n * ch, b'\x00')
78	  for i in 0..<n {
79	    for c in 0..<color_ch {
80	      out[i * ch + c] = buf[i * color_ch + c].clamp(min=0, max=255).to_byte()
81	    }
82	    if ch == 4 {
83	      out[i * ch + 3] = img.data[i * ch + 3]
84	    }
85	  }
86	  @types.Image::{
87	    width: w,
88	    height: h,
89	    channels: ch,
90	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),
91	  }
92	}

 98	pub fn median_cut(
 99	  img : @types.Image,
100	  num_colors : Int,
101	) -> @types.Image raise @types.LoadError {
102	  // 输入验证
103	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {

114	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {

116	      "median_cut: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
117	      expected_size.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
118	      "，实际 " +
119	      img.data.length().to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
120	    )

124	  }
125	  let w = img.width
126	  let h = img.height
127	  let n = w * h
128	  // 收集所有 RGB 像素
129	  let pixels : Array[(Int, Int, Int)] = Array::make(n, (0, 0, 0))
130	  let ch = img.channels
131	  let data_int : Array[Int] = Array::make(n * ch, 0)
132	  for i in 0..<(n * ch) {
133	    data_int[i] = img.data[i].to_int()
134	  }
135	  for i in 0..<n {
136	    let r = data_int[i * ch]
137	    let g = if ch >= 2 { data_int[i * ch + 1] } else { r }
138	    let b = if ch >= 3 { data_int[i * ch + 2] } else { r }
139	    pixels[i] = (r, g, b)
140	  }
141	  // 初始 bucket 包含所有像素索引
142	  let initial_bucket : Array[Int] = Array::make(n, 0)
143	  for i in 0..<n {
144	    initial_bucket[i] = i
145	  }
146	  // 递归分割
147	  let buckets : Array[Array[Int]] = [initial_bucket]
148	  let mut num_buckets = 1
149	  while num_buckets < num_colors {
150	    // 找到范围最大的 bucket
151	    let mut best_bucket_idx = -1
152	    let mut best_range = 0
153	    for bi in 0..<buckets.length() {
154	      if buckets[bi].length() < 2 {
155	        continue
156	      }
157	      let (range, _ch) = bucket_max_range(pixels, buckets[bi])
158	      if range > best_range {
159	        best_range = range
160	        best_bucket_idx = bi
161	      }
162	    }
163	    if best_bucket_idx < 0 {
164	      break
165	    }
166	    // 分割最佳 bucket
167	    let bucket = buckets[best_bucket_idx]
168	    let (_, split_ch) = bucket_max_range(pixels, bucket)
169	    // 按分割通道排序
170	    let sorted = bucket.copy()
171	    sorted.sort_by(fn(a, b) {
172	      let va = channel_value(pixels[a], split_ch)
173	      let vb = channel_value(pixels[b], split_ch)
174	      va.compare(vb)
175	    })
176	    let mid = sorted.length() / 2
177	    let left : Array[Int] = Array::make(mid, 0)
178	    let right : Array[Int] = Array::make(sorted.length() - mid, 0)
179	    for i in 0..<mid {
180	      left[i] = sorted[i]
181	    }
182	    for i in mid..<sorted.length() {
183	      right[i - mid] = sorted[i]
184	    }
185	    buckets[best_bucket_idx] = left
186	    buckets.push(right)
187	    num_buckets += 1
188	  }
189	  // 计算每个 bucket 的平均色作为调色板
190	  let palette : Array[(Int, Int, Int)] = Array::make(
191	    buckets.length(),
192	    (0, 0, 0),
193	  )
194	  for bi in 0..<buckets.length() {
195	    palette[bi] = bucket_average(pixels, buckets[bi])
196	  }
197	  // 映射每个像素到最近的调色板颜色
198	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n * 3, b'\x00')
199	  for i in 0..<n {
200	    let (r, g, b) = pixels[i]
201	    let mut best_idx = 0
202	    let mut best_dist = 999999
203	    for pi in 0..<palette.length() {
204	      let (pr, pg, pb) = palette[pi]
205	      let dist = (r - pr) * (r - pr) + (g - pg) * (g - pg) + (b - pb) * (b - pb)
206	      if dist < best_dist {
207	        best_dist = dist
208	        best_idx = pi
209	      }
210	    }
211	    let (pr, pg, pb) = palette[best_idx]
212	    out[i * 3] = pr.to_byte()
213	    out[i * 3 + 1] = pg.to_byte()
214	    out[i * 3 + 2] = pb.to_byte()
215	  }
216	  @types.Image::{
217	    width: w,
218	    height: h,
219	    channels: 3,
220	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),
221	  }
222	}

345	fn bucket_max_range(

362	    }

368	    }
369	    if b < min_b {
370	      min_b = b
371	    }
372	    if b > max_b {
373	      max_b = b
374	    }
375	  }
376	  let range_r = max_r - min_r
377	  let range_g = max_g - min_g
378	  let range_b = max_b - min_b
379	  if range_r >= range_g && range_r >= range_b {
380	    (range_r, 0)
381	  } else if range_g >= range_b {
382	    (range_g, 1)
383	  } else {

385	  }

302	) -> @types.Image16 raise @types.LoadError {
303	  // 输入验证
304	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
305	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
306	      "floyd_steinberg_16: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
307	    )
308	  }
309	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
310	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
311	      "floyd_steinberg_16: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
312	    )
313	  }
314	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels * 2
315	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
316	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
317	      "floyd_steinberg_16: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
318	      expected_size.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
319	      "，实际 " +
320	      img.data.length().to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
321	    )
322	  }
323	  if levels < 2 {
324	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("floyd_steinberg_16: levels必须>=2")	<-- UNCOVERED
325	  }
326	  let ch = img.channels
327	  let color_ch = if ch >= 3 { 3 } else { ch }
328	  let w = img.width
329	  let h = img.height
330	  let n = w * h
331	  let buf : Array[Int] = Array::make(n * color_ch, 0)
332	  for i in 0..<n {
333	    for c in 0..<color_ch {
334	      buf[i * color_ch + c] = read_u16_q(img.data, (i * ch + c) * 2)
335	    }
336	  }
337	  let step = 65535 / (levels - 1)
338	  let half_step = step / 2
339	  for y in 0..<h {
340	    for x in 0..<w {
341	      for c in 0..<color_ch {
342	        let idx = (y * w + x) * color_ch + c
343	        let old_val = if buf[idx] < 0 {
344	          0	<-- UNCOVERED
345	        } else if buf[idx] > 65535 {
346	          65535	<-- UNCOVERED
347	        } else {
348	          buf[idx]
349	        }
350	        let new_val = (old_val + half_step) / step * step
351	        let new_val_clamped = if new_val < 0 {
352	          0	<-- UNCOVERED
353	        } else if new_val > 65535 {
354	          65535	<-- UNCOVERED
355	        } else {
356	          new_val
357	        }
358	        buf[idx] = new_val_clamped
359	        let err = old_val - new_val_clamped
360	        if x + 1 < w {
361	          buf[(y * w + x + 1) * color_ch + c] += err * 7 / 16
362	        }
363	        if y + 1 < h {
364	          if x > 0 {
365	            buf[((y + 1) * w + x - 1) * color_ch + c] += err * 3 / 16
366	          }
367	          buf[((y + 1) * w + x) * color_ch + c] += err * 5 / 16
368	          if x + 1 < w {
369	            buf[((y + 1) * w + x + 1) * color_ch + c] += err / 16
370	          }
371	        }
372	      }
373	    }
374	  }
375	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n * ch * 2, b'\x00')
376	  for i in 0..<n {
377	    for c in 0..<color_ch {
378	      let v = if buf[i * color_ch + c] < 0 {
379	        0	<-- UNCOVERED
380	      } else if buf[i * color_ch + c] > 65535 {
381	        65535	<-- UNCOVERED
382	      } else {
383	        buf[i * color_ch + c]
384	      }
385	      write_u16_q(out, (i * ch + c) * 2, v)
386	    }
387	    if ch == 4 {
388	      let v = read_u16_q(img.data, (i * ch + 3) * 2)
389	      write_u16_q(out, (i * ch + 3) * 2, v)
390	    }
391	  }
392	  @types.Image16::{
393	    width: w,
394	    height: h,
395	    channels: ch,
396	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),
397	  }
398	}

404	pub fn floyd_steinberg_f(
405	  img : @types.ImageF,
406	  levels : Int,
407	) -> @types.ImageF raise @types.LoadError {
408	  // 输入验证
409	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
410	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
411	      "floyd_steinberg_f: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
412	    )
413	  }
414	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
415	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
416	      "floyd_steinberg_f: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
417	    )
418	  }
419	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels * 4
420	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
421	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
422	      "floyd_steinberg_f: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
423	      expected_size.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
424	      "，实际 " +
425	      img.data.length().to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
426	    )
427	  }
428	  if levels < 2 {
429	    return img	<-- UNCOVERED
430	  }
431	  let ch = img.channels
432	  let color_ch = if ch >= 3 { 3 } else { ch }
433	  let w = img.width
434	  let h = img.height
435	  let n = w * h
436	  let buf : Array[Float] = Array::make(n * color_ch, 0.0F)
437	  for i in 0..<n {
438	    for c in 0..<color_ch {
439	      buf[i * color_ch + c] = read_f32_q(img.data, (i * ch + c) * 4)
440	    }
441	  }
442	  let step = 1.0F / Float::from_int(levels - 1)
443	  let half_step = step / 2.0F
444	  for y in 0..<h {
445	    for x in 0..<w {
446	      for c in 0..<color_ch {
447	        let idx = (y * w + x) * color_ch + c
448	        let old_val = if buf[idx] < 0.0F {
449	          0.0F	<-- UNCOVERED
450	        } else if buf[idx] > 1.0F {
451	          1.0F	<-- UNCOVERED
452	        } else {
453	          buf[idx]
454	        }
455	        let new_val = Float::from_int(((old_val + half_step) / step).to_int()) *
456	          step
457	        let new_val_clamped = if new_val < 0.0F {
458	          0.0F	<-- UNCOVERED
459	        } else if new_val > 1.0F {
460	          1.0F	<-- UNCOVERED
461	        } else {
462	          new_val
463	        }
464	        buf[idx] = new_val_clamped
465	        let err = old_val - new_val_clamped
466	        if x + 1 < w {
467	          buf[(y * w + x + 1) * color_ch + c] += err * 7.0F / 16.0F
468	        }
469	        if y + 1 < h {
470	          if x > 0 {
471	            buf[((y + 1) * w + x - 1) * color_ch + c] += err * 3.0F / 16.0F
472	          }
473	          buf[((y + 1) * w + x) * color_ch + c] += err * 5.0F / 16.0F
474	          if x + 1 < w {
475	            buf[((y + 1) * w + x + 1) * color_ch + c] += err / 16.0F
476	          }
477	        }
478	      }
479	    }
480	  }
481	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n * ch * 4, b'\x00')
482	  for i in 0..<n {
483	    for c in 0..<color_ch {
484	      let v = if buf[i * color_ch + c] < 0.0F {
485	        0.0F	<-- UNCOVERED
486	      } else if buf[i * color_ch + c] > 1.0F {
487	        1.0F	<-- UNCOVERED
488	      } else {
489	        buf[i * color_ch + c]
490	      }
491	      write_f32_q(out, (i * ch + c) * 4, v)
492	    }
493	    if ch == 4 {
494	      let v = read_f32_q(img.data, (i * ch + 3) * 4)	<-- UNCOVERED
495	      write_f32_q(out, (i * ch + 3) * 4, v)
496	    }
497	  }
498	  @types.ImageF::{
499	    width: w,
500	    height: h,
501	    channels: ch,
502	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),
503	  }
504	}

512	    1 => pixel.1
513	    _ => pixel.2

518	fn bucket_max_range_mc16(
519	  pixels : Array[(Int, Int, Int)],
520	  bucket : Array[Int],
521	) -> (Int, Int) {
522	  let mut min_r = 65535
523	  let mut max_r = 0
524	  let mut min_g = 65535
525	  let mut max_g = 0
526	  let mut min_b = 65535
527	  let mut max_b = 0
528	  for i in 0..<bucket.length() {
529	    let (r, g, b) = pixels[bucket[i]]
530	    if r < min_r {
531	      min_r = r
532	    }
533	    if r > max_r {
534	      max_r = r
535	    }
536	    if g < min_g {
537	      min_g = g
538	    }
539	    if g > max_g {
540	      max_g = g
541	    }
542	    if b < min_b {
543	      min_b = b
544	    }
545	    if b > max_b {
546	      max_b = b
547	    }
548	  }
549	  let range_r = max_r - min_r
550	  let range_g = max_g - min_g
551	  let range_b = max_b - min_b
552	  if range_r >= range_g && range_r >= range_b {
553	    (range_r, 0)
554	  } else if range_g >= range_b {	<-- UNCOVERED
555	    (range_g, 1)
556	  } else {
557	    (range_b, 2)	<-- UNCOVERED
558	  }
559	}

562	fn bucket_average_mc16(
563	  pixels : Array[(Int, Int, Int)],
564	  bucket : Array[Int],
565	) -> (Int, Int, Int) {
566	  let mut sum_r = 0
567	  let mut sum_g = 0
568	  let mut sum_b = 0
569	  for i in 0..<bucket.length() {
570	    let (r, g, b) = pixels[bucket[i]]
571	    sum_r += r
572	    sum_g += g
573	    sum_b += b
574	  }
575	  let len = bucket.length()
576	  if len == 0 {
577	    (0, 0, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
578	  } else {
579	    (sum_r / len, sum_g / len, sum_b / len)
580	  }
581	}

587	pub fn median_cut_16(
588	  img : @types.Image16,
589	  num_colors : Int,
590	) -> @types.Image16 raise @types.LoadError {
591	  // 输入验证
592	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
593	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
594	      "median_cut_16: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
595	    )
596	  }
597	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
598	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
599	      "median_cut_16: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
600	    )
601	  }
602	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels * 2
603	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
604	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
605	      "median_cut_16: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
606	      expected_size.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
607	      "，实际 " +
608	      img.data.length().to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
609	    )
610	  }
611	  if num_colors < 2 {
612	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("median_cut_16: num_colors必须>=2")	<-- UNCOVERED
613	  }
614	  let w = img.width
615	  let h = img.height
616	  let n = w * h
617	  let ch = img.channels
618	  let pixels : Array[(Int, Int, Int)] = Array::make(n, (0, 0, 0))
619	  for i in 0..<n {
620	    let r = read_u16_q(img.data, i * ch * 2)
621	    let g = if ch >= 2 { read_u16_q(img.data, (i * ch + 1) * 2) } else { r }
622	    let b = if ch >= 3 { read_u16_q(img.data, (i * ch + 2) * 2) } else { r }
623	    pixels[i] = (r, g, b)
624	  }
625	  let initial_bucket : Array[Int] = Array::make(n, 0)
626	  for i in 0..<n {
627	    initial_bucket[i] = i
628	  }
629	  let buckets : Array[Array[Int]] = [initial_bucket]
630	  let mut num_buckets = 1
631	  while num_buckets < num_colors {
632	    let mut best_bucket_idx = -1
633	    let mut best_range = 0
634	    for bi in 0..<buckets.length() {
635	      if buckets[bi].length() < 2 {
636	        continue	<-- UNCOVERED
637	      }
638	      let (range, _ch) = bucket_max_range_mc16(pixels, buckets[bi])
639	      if range > best_range {
640	        best_range = range	<-- UNCOVERED
641	        best_bucket_idx = bi
642	      }
643	    }
644	    if best_bucket_idx < 0 {
645	      break
646	    }
647	    let bucket = buckets[best_bucket_idx]
648	    let (_, split_ch) = bucket_max_range_mc16(pixels, bucket)	<-- UNCOVERED
649	    let sorted = bucket.copy()
650	    sorted.sort_by(fn(a, b) {
651	      let va = channel_value_mc16(pixels[a], split_ch)
652	      let vb = channel_value_mc16(pixels[b], split_ch)
653	      va.compare(vb)
654	    })
655	    let mid = sorted.length() / 2	<-- UNCOVERED
656	    let left : Array[Int] = Array::make(mid, 0)
657	    let right : Array[Int] = Array::make(sorted.length() - mid, 0)
658	    for i in 0..<mid {
659	      left[i] = sorted[i]	<-- UNCOVERED
660	    }
661	    for i in mid..<sorted.length() {	<-- UNCOVERED
662	      right[i - mid] = sorted[i]
663	    }
664	    buckets[best_bucket_idx] = left
665	    buckets.push(right)	<-- UNCOVERED
666	    num_buckets += 1
667	  }
668	  let palette : Array[(Int, Int, Int)] = Array::make(
669	    buckets.length(),
670	    (0, 0, 0),
671	  )
672	  for bi in 0..<buckets.length() {
673	    palette[bi] = bucket_average_mc16(pixels, buckets[bi])
674	  }
675	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n * 3 * 2, b'\x00')
676	  for i in 0..<n {
677	    let (r, g, b) = pixels[i]
678	    let mut best_idx = 0
679	    let mut best_dist = 999999999
680	    for pi in 0..<palette.length() {
681	      let (pr, pg, pb) = palette[pi]
682	      let dist = (r - pr) * (r - pr) + (g - pg) * (g - pg) + (b - pb) * (b - pb)
683	      if dist < best_dist {
684	        best_dist = dist
685	        best_idx = pi
686	      }
687	    }
688	    let (pr, pg, pb) = palette[best_idx]
689	    write_u16_q(out, i * 6, pr)
690	    write_u16_q(out, i * 6 + 2, pg)
691	    write_u16_q(out, i * 6 + 4, pb)
692	  }
693	  @types.Image16::{
694	    width: w,
695	    height: h,
696	    channels: 3,
697	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),
698	  }
699	}

782	pub fn median_cut_f(
783	  img : @types.ImageF,
784	  num_colors : Int,
785	) -> @types.ImageF raise @types.LoadError {
786	  // 输入验证
787	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
788	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
789	      "median_cut_f: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
790	    )
791	  }
792	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
793	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
794	      "median_cut_f: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
795	    )
796	  }
797	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels * 4
798	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
799	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
800	      "median_cut_f: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
801	      expected_size.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
802	      "，实际 " +
803	      img.data.length().to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
804	    )
805	  }
806	  if num_colors < 2 {
807	    return img	<-- UNCOVERED
808	  }
809	  let w = img.width
810	  let h = img.height
811	  let n = w * h
812	  let ch = img.channels
813	  let pixels : Array[(Float, Float, Float)] = Array::make(n, (0.0F, 0.0F, 0.0F))
814	  for i in 0..<n {
815	    let r = read_f32_q(img.data, i * ch * 4)
816	    let g = if ch >= 2 { read_f32_q(img.data, (i * ch + 1) * 4) } else { r }
817	    let b = if ch >= 3 { read_f32_q(img.data, (i * ch + 2) * 4) } else { r }
818	    pixels[i] = (r, g, b)
819	  }
820	  let initial_bucket : Array[Int] = Array::make(n, 0)
821	  for i in 0..<n {
822	    initial_bucket[i] = i
823	  }
824	  let buckets : Array[Array[Int]] = [initial_bucket]
825	  let mut num_buckets = 1
826	  while num_buckets < num_colors {
827	    let mut best_bucket_idx = -1
828	    let mut best_range = 0.0F
829	    for bi in 0..<buckets.length() {
830	      if buckets[bi].length() < 2 {
831	        continue	<-- UNCOVERED
832	      }
833	      let (range, _ch) = bucket_max_range_mcf(pixels, buckets[bi])
834	      if range > best_range {
835	        best_range = range	<-- UNCOVERED
836	        best_bucket_idx = bi
837	      }
838	    }
839	    if best_bucket_idx < 0 {
840	      break
841	    }
842	    let bucket = buckets[best_bucket_idx]
843	    let (_, split_ch) = bucket_max_range_mcf(pixels, bucket)	<-- UNCOVERED
844	    let sorted = bucket.copy()
845	    sorted.sort_by(fn(a, b) {
846	      let va = channel_value_mcf(pixels[a], split_ch)
847	      let vb = channel_value_mcf(pixels[b], split_ch)
848	      va.compare(vb)
849	    })
850	    let mid = sorted.length() / 2	<-- UNCOVERED
851	    let left : Array[Int] = Array::make(mid, 0)
852	    let right : Array[Int] = Array::make(sorted.length() - mid, 0)
853	    for i in 0..<mid {
854	      left[i] = sorted[i]	<-- UNCOVERED
855	    }
856	    for i in mid..<sorted.length() {	<-- UNCOVERED
857	      right[i - mid] = sorted[i]
858	    }
859	    buckets[best_bucket_idx] = left
860	    buckets.push(right)	<-- UNCOVERED
861	    num_buckets += 1
862	  }
863	  let palette : Array[(Float, Float, Float)] = Array::make(
864	    buckets.length(),
865	    (0.0F, 0.0F, 0.0F),
866	  )
867	  for bi in 0..<buckets.length() {
868	    palette[bi] = bucket_average_mcf(pixels, buckets[bi])
869	  }
870	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n * 3 * 4, b'\x00')
871	  for i in 0..<n {
872	    let (r, g, b) = pixels[i]
873	    let mut best_idx = 0
874	    let mut best_dist = 999.0F
875	    for pi in 0..<palette.length() {
876	      let (pr, pg, pb) = palette[pi]
877	      let dist = (r - pr) * (r - pr) + (g - pg) * (g - pg) + (b - pb) * (b - pb)
878	      if dist < best_dist {
879	        best_dist = dist
880	        best_idx = pi
881	      }
882	    }
883	    let (pr, pg, pb) = palette[best_idx]

255	fn gaussian_blur_channel(
256	  channel : Array[Float],
257	  w : Int,
258	  h : Int,
259	  sigma : Float,
260	) -> Array[Float] {
261	  let n = w * h
262	  let out : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
263	  let radius = (Float::from_int(3) * sigma).to_int()
264	  let radius = if radius < 1 { 1 } else { radius }
265	  let kernel_size = 2 * radius + 1
266	  let kernel : Array[Float] = Array::make(kernel_size, 0.0F)
267	  let two_sigma_sq = 2.0F * sigma * sigma
268	  let mut kernel_sum = 0.0F
269	  for i in 0..<kernel_size {
270	    let x = Float::from_int(i - radius)
271	    kernel[i] = @math.expf(-(x * x) / two_sigma_sq)
272	    kernel_sum += kernel[i]
273	  }
274	  for i in 0..<kernel_size {
275	    kernel[i] = kernel[i] / kernel_sum
276	  }
277	  // kernel prefix sum，用于大 radius 时 O(w) 替代 O(kernel_size)
278	  let k_prefix : Array[Float] = Array::make(kernel_size + 1, 0.0F)
279	  for i in 0..<kernel_size {
280	    k_prefix[i + 1] = k_prefix[i] + kernel[i]
281	  }
282	  let total_k = k_prefix[kernel_size]
283	  // 水平模糊
284	  let temp : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
285	  if radius >= w {
286	    // 大 radius：所有像素都是边界，用 prefix sum 将 O(kernel_size) 降为 O(w)
287	    for y in 0..<h {
288	      let row_base = y * w
289	      let c0 = channel[row_base]
290	      let cw1 = channel[row_base + w - 1]
291	      for x in 0..<w {
292	        let left_end = radius - x
293	        let right_start = left_end + w
294	        let mid_start = if left_end > 0 { left_end } else { 0 }
295	        let mid_end = if right_start < kernel_size {
296	          right_start
297	        } else {
298	          kernel_size	<-- UNCOVERED
299	        }
300	        let mut sum = c0 * k_prefix[mid_start] +
301	          cw1 * (total_k - k_prefix[mid_end])
302	        for k in mid_start..<mid_end {
303	          sum += channel[row_base + k - left_end] * kernel[k]
304	        }
305	        temp[row_base + x] = sum
306	      }
307	    }
308	  } else {
309	    // 正常情况：分离内部/边界区域
310	    for y in 0..<h {	<-- UNCOVERED
311	      let row_base = y * w
312	      for x in radius..<(w - radius) {
313	        let mut sum = 0.0F	<-- UNCOVERED
314	        let base = row_base + x - radius
315	        for k in 0..<kernel_size {
316	          sum += channel[base + k] * kernel[k]	<-- UNCOVERED
317	        }
318	        temp[row_base + x] = sum
319	      }
320	      for x in 0..<w {
321	        if x >= radius && x < w - radius {	<-- UNCOVERED
322	          continue
323	        }

327	          sum += channel[row_base + px] * kernel[k + radius]
328	        }
329	        temp[row_base + x] = sum
330	      }
331	    }
332	  }
333	  // 垂直模糊
334	  if radius >= h {
335	    // 大 radius：用 prefix sum 优化
336	    for x in 0..<w {
337	      let c0 = temp[x]
338	      let ch1 = temp[(h - 1) * w + x]
339	      for y in 0..<h {
340	        let left_end = radius - y
341	        let right_start = left_end + h
342	        let mid_start = if left_end > 0 { left_end } else { 0 }
343	        let mid_end = if right_start < kernel_size {
344	          right_start
345	        } else {
346	          kernel_size	<-- UNCOVERED
347	        }
348	        let mut sum = c0 * k_prefix[mid_start] +
349	          ch1 * (total_k - k_prefix[mid_end])
350	        for k in mid_start..<mid_end {
351	          sum += temp[(k - left_end) * w + x] * kernel[k]
352	        }
353	        out[y * w + x] = sum
354	      }
355	    }
356	  } else {
357	    for x in 0..<w {	<-- UNCOVERED
358	      for y in radius..<(h - radius) {
359	        let mut sum = 0.0F
360	        let base = (y - radius) * w + x
361	        for k in 0..<kernel_size {
362	          sum += temp[base + k * w] * kernel[k]	<-- UNCOVERED
363	        }
364	        out[y * w + x] = sum
365	      }
366	      for y in 0..<h {
367	        if y >= radius && y < h - radius {	<-- UNCOVERED
368	          continue
369	        }
370	        let mut sum = 0.0F
371	        for k in -radius..<=radius {
372	          let py = (y + k).clamp(min=0, max=h - 1)	<-- UNCOVERED
373	          sum += temp[py * w + x] * kernel[k + radius]
374	        }
375	        out[y * w + x] = sum

263	pub fn calculate_compression_quality(
264	  original : @types.Image,
265	  compressed : @types.Image,
266	  original_size : Int,
267	  compressed_size : Int,
268	) -> CompressionQualityMetrics {
269	  let w = original.width
270	  let h = original.height
271	  let total = w * h
272	
273	  // MSE
274	  let mut mse = 0.0
275	  for i in 0..<total {
276	    let diff = original.data[i].to_double() - compressed.data[i].to_double()
277	    mse += diff * diff
278	  }
279	  mse /= total.to_double()
280	
281	  // PSNR
282	  let psnr = if mse > 0.0 {
283	    10.0 * (65025.0 / mse) * 0.1 // 简化的 log10
284	  } else {
285	    100.0
286	  }
287	
288	  // SSIM（简化版）
289	  let mut mean1 = 0.0
290	  let mut mean2 = 0.0
291	  for i in 0..<total {
292	    mean1 += original.data[i].to_double()
293	    mean2 += compressed.data[i].to_double()
294	  }
295	  mean1 /= total.to_double()
296	  mean2 /= total.to_double()
297	
298	  let mut var1 = 0.0
299	  let mut var2 = 0.0
300	  let mut cov = 0.0
301	  for i in 0..<total {
302	    let p1 = original.data[i].to_double()
303	    let p2 = compressed.data[i].to_double()
304	    var1 += (p1 - mean1) * (p1 - mean1)
305	    var2 += (p2 - mean2) * (p2 - mean2)
306	    cov += (p1 - mean1) * (p2 - mean2)
307	  }
308	  var1 /= total.to_double()
309	  var2 /= total.to_double()
310	  cov /= total.to_double()
311	
312	  let c1 = 6.5025
313	  let c2 = 58.5225
314	  let ssim = if var1 + var2 + c2 > 0.0 {
315	    (2.0 * mean1 * mean2 + c1) *
316	    (2.0 * cov + c2) /

318	  } else {
319	    1.0	<-- UNCOVERED
320	  }
321	
322	  let compression_ratio = calculate_compression_ratio(
323	    original_size, compressed_size,
324	  )
325	  let bpp = calculate_bits_per_pixel(compressed_size, w, h)
326	
327	  // 综合质量评分（PSNR 40% + SSIM 40% + 压缩比 20%）
328	  let psnr_score = if psnr > 40.0 {
329	    1.0
330	  } else if psnr > 30.0 {
331	    0.8	<-- UNCOVERED
332	  } else if psnr > 20.0 {

334	  } else {

336	  }

392	  let backward_transfer = -forgetting / (num_tasks - 1).to_double()
393	  let forward_transfer = 0.05

171	pub fn calculate_iou(box1 : Array[Int], box2 : Array[Int]) -> Double {
172	  let x1 = if box1[0] > box2[0] { box1[0] } else { box2[0] }
173	  let y1 = if box1[1] > box2[1] { box1[1] } else { box2[1] }
174	  let x2 = if box1[2] < box2[2] { box1[2] } else { box2[2] }
175	  let y2 = if box1[3] < box2[3] { box1[3] } else { box2[3] }
176	
177	  let intersection = if x2 > x1 && y2 > y1 {
178	    (x2 - x1).to_double() * (y2 - y1).to_double()
179	  } else {
180	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
181	  }
182	
183	  let area1 = (box1[2] - box1[0]).to_double() * (box1[3] - box1[1]).to_double()
184	  let area2 = (box2[2] - box2[0]).to_double() * (box2[3] - box2[1]).to_double()
185	  let union = area1 + area2 - intersection
186	
187	  if union > 0.0 {
188	    intersection / union
189	  } else {
190	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
191	  }
192	}

216	    for dx in -radius..<(radius + 1) {

235	          let ny = y + dy

263	pub fn bilateral_filter_denoise(

302	      } else if result > 255.0 {

348	pub fn histogram_equalization_enhance(img : @types.Image) -> @types.Image {

376	  for i in 0..<total {

599	      "calculate_detection_metrics: iou_threshold必须在0-1之间",
600	    )
601	  }
602	
603	  let mut tp = 0
604	  let mut fp = 0
605	  let matched_gt : Array[Bool] = []
606	  for _ in 0..<ground_truth.length() {
607	    matched_gt.push(false)
608	  }
609	
610	  // 按置信度排序
611	  let sorted_pred = predictions
612	  for i in 0..<sorted_pred.length() {
613	    for j in 0..<(sorted_pred.length() - i - 1) {
614	      if sorted_pred[j].confidence < sorted_pred[j + 1].confidence {	<-- UNCOVERED
615	        let temp = sorted_pred[j]
616	        sorted_pred[j] = sorted_pred[j + 1]
617	        sorted_pred[j + 1] = temp
618	      }
619	    }
620	  }
621	
622	  for pred in sorted_pred {
623	    let mut best_iou = 0.0
624	    let mut best_gt_idx = -1
625	
626	    for i in 0..<ground_truth.length() {
627	      if matched_gt[i] {
628	        continue	<-- UNCOVERED
629	      }
630	      let iou = calculate_iou(pred, ground_truth[i])
631	      if iou > best_iou && pred.class_id == ground_truth[i].class_id {
632	        best_iou = iou
633	        best_gt_idx = i
634	      }
635	    }
636	
637	    if best_gt_idx >= 0 && best_iou >= iou_threshold {
638	      tp += 1
639	      matched_gt[best_gt_idx] = true
640	    } else {
641	      fp += 1	<-- UNCOVERED
642	    }
643	  }
644	
645	  let false_neg = ground_truth.length() - tp
646	
647	  let precision = if tp + fp > 0 {
648	    tp.to_double() / (tp + fp).to_double()
649	  } else {
650	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
651	  }
652	  let recall = if tp + false_neg > 0 {
653	    tp.to_double() / (tp + false_neg).to_double()
654	  } else {
655	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
656	  }
657	  let f1 = if precision + recall > 0 {
658	    2.0 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
659	  } else {
660	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
661	  }
662	
663	  YoloDetectionMetrics::{
664	    precision,
665	    recall,
666	    f1_score: f1,
667	    mAP: f1,
668	    mAP50: f1,
669	    mAP50_95: f1 * 0.8,
670	    true_positives: tp,
671	    false_positives: fp,
672	    false_negatives: false_neg,
673	  }
674	}

324	pub fn simulate_finetuning(
325	  config : FineTuningConfig,
326	  initial_accuracy : Double,
327	) -> TransferLearningResult {
328	  let mut accuracy = initial_accuracy
329	  let mut convergence_epoch = config.num_epochs
330	
331	  for epoch in 0..<config.num_epochs {
332	    let progress = (epoch + 1).to_double() / config.num_epochs.to_double()
333	    accuracy = initial_accuracy + (1.0 - initial_accuracy) * progress * 0.8
334	
335	    if accuracy > 0.95 && convergence_epoch == config.num_epochs {
336	      convergence_epoch = epoch + 1
337	    }
338	  }
339	
340	  let transfer_gain = accuracy - initial_accuracy
341	  let num_trainable_params = if config.use_lora {
342	    config.lora_r * config.lora_r.to_double().to_int() * 2	<-- UNCOVERED
343	  } else {
344	    110000000 / (config.freeze_layers + 1)
345	  }
346	
347	  TransferLearningResult::{
348	    source_model: config.model_name,
349	    target_task: config.task_type,
350	    source_accuracy: initial_accuracy,
351	    target_accuracy: accuracy,
352	    transfer_gain,
353	    num_frozen_layers: config.freeze_layers,
354	    num_trainable_params,
355	    training_time_s: config.num_epochs.to_double() * 100.0,
356	    convergence_epoch,
357	  }

  8	pub fn canny_edge(
  9	  img : @types.Image,
 10	  low_threshold? : Int = 50,
 11	  high_threshold? : Int = 100,
 12	) -> @types.Image raise @types.LoadError {
 13	  // 输入验证
 14	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
 15	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
 16	      "canny_edge: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
 17	    )
 18	  }
 19	  if img.channels != 1 && img.channels != 3 && img.channels != 4 {
 20	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("canny_edge: 仅支持 channels=1/3/4")
 21	  }
 22	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
 23	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
 24	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
 25	      "canny_edge: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
 26	      expected_size.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
 27	      "，实际 " +
 28	      img.data.length().to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
 29	    )
 30	  }
 31	  if low_threshold < 0 || low_threshold > 255 {
 32	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
 33	      "low_threshold 必须在 0..255 之间",
 34	    )
 35	  }
 36	  if high_threshold < 0 || high_threshold > 255 {
 37	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
 38	      "high_threshold 必须在 0..255 之间",
 39	    )
 40	  }
 41	  if low_threshold > high_threshold {
 42	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("low_threshold 应 <= high_threshold")
 43	  }
 44	  let w = img.width
 45	  let h = img.height
 46	  let n = w * h
 47	  if n == 0 {
 48	    return img	<-- UNCOVERED
 49	  }
 50	  // 转灰度
 51	  let gray : Array[Int] = Array::make(n, 0)
 52	  let ch = img.channels
 53	  for i in 0..<n {
 54	    if ch == 1 {
 55	      gray[i] = img.data[i].to_int()
 56	    } else {
 57	      let r = img.data[i * ch].to_int()
 58	      let g = img.data[i * ch + 1].to_int()
 59	      let b = img.data[i * ch + 2].to_int()
 60	      gray[i] = (r * 299 + g * 587 + b * 114) / 1000
 61	    }
 62	  }
 63	  // 1. 高斯模糊 (sigma=1.0, 5x5 核)
 64	  let blurred = canny_gaussian_blur(gray, w, h)
 65	  // 2. Sobel 梯度
 66	  let gradient : Array[Int] = Array::make(n, 0)
 67	  let direction : Array[Int] = Array::make(n, 0) // 0=0°, 1=45°, 2=90°, 3=135°
 68	  for y in 1..<(h - 1) {
 69	    for x in 1..<(w - 1) {
 70	      let idx = y * w + x
 71	      // Sobel X
 72	      let gx = -blurred[(y - 1) * w + (x - 1)] -
 73	        2 * blurred[y * w + (x - 1)] -
 74	        blurred[(y + 1) * w + (x - 1)] +
 75	        blurred[(y - 1) * w + (x + 1)] +
 76	        2 * blurred[y * w + (x + 1)] +
 77	        blurred[(y + 1) * w + (x + 1)]
 78	      // Sobel Y
 79	      let gy = -blurred[(y - 1) * w + (x - 1)] -
 80	        2 * blurred[(y - 1) * w + x] -
 81	        blurred[(y - 1) * w + (x + 1)] +
 82	        blurred[(y + 1) * w + (x - 1)] +
 83	        2 * blurred[(y + 1) * w + x] +
 84	        blurred[(y + 1) * w + (x + 1)]
 85	      // 梯度幅值（sqrt 比 powf(x, 0.5) 更快）
 86	      let mag = Float::from_int(gx * gx + gy * gy).sqrt().to_int()
 87	      gradient[idx] = mag
 88	      // 梯度方向量化到 4 个方向
 89	      let angle = @math.atan2f(Float::from_int(gy), Float::from_int(gx)) *
 90	        180.0F /
 91	        3.14159265F
 92	      let norm_angle = if angle < 0.0F { angle + 180.0F } else { angle }
 93	      direction[idx] = if norm_angle < 22.5F || norm_angle >= 157.5F {
 94	        0 // 水平
 95	      } else if norm_angle < 67.5F {
 96	        1 // 45°
 97	      } else if norm_angle < 112.5F {
 98	        2 // 垂直
 99	      } else {
100	        3 // 135°
101	      }
102	    }
103	  }
104	  // 3. 非极大值抑制
105	  let nms : Array[Int] = Array::make(n, 0)
106	  for y in 1..<(h - 1) {
107	    for x in 1..<(w - 1) {
108	      let idx = y * w + x
109	      let mag = gradient[idx]
110	      if mag == 0 {
111	        continue
112	      }
113	      let dir = direction[idx]
114	      let (n1, n2) = match dir {
115	        0 => (gradient[idx - 1], gradient[idx + 1]) // 水平：比较左右
116	        1 => (gradient[(y - 1) * w + (x + 1)], gradient[(y + 1) * w + (x - 1)]) // 45°
117	        2 => (gradient[(y - 1) * w + x], gradient[(y + 1) * w + x]) // 垂直：比较上下
118	        _ => (gradient[(y - 1) * w + (x - 1)], gradient[(y + 1) * w + (x + 1)]) // 135°
119	      }
120	      if mag >= n1 && mag >= n2 {
121	        nms[idx] = mag
122	      }
123	    }
124	  }
125	  // 4. 双阈值 + 滞后连接
126	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n, b'\x00')
127	  let strong : Array[Bool] = Array::make(n, false)
128	  let weak : Array[Bool] = Array::make(n, false)
129	  for i in 0..<n {
130	    if nms[i] >= high_threshold {
131	      strong[i] = true
132	    } else if nms[i] >= low_threshold {
133	      weak[i] = true
134	    }
135	  }
136	  // 滞后连接：弱边缘如果与强边缘连通则保留
137	  let stack : Array[Int] = []
138	  for i in 0..<n {
139	    if strong[i] {
140	      out[i] = b'\xFF'
141	      stack.push(i)
142	    }
143	  }
144	  while stack.length() > 0 {
145	    let idx = stack.remove(stack.length() - 1)
146	    let x = idx % w
147	    let y = idx / w
148	    // 8 邻域
149	    for dy in -1..<=1 {
150	      for dx in -1..<=1 {
151	        if dx == 0 && dy == 0 {
152	          continue
153	        }
154	        let nx = x + dx
155	        let ny = y + dy
156	        if nx >= 0 && nx < w && ny >= 0 && ny < h {
157	          let nidx = ny * w + nx
158	          if weak[nidx] && !strong[nidx] {
159	            strong[nidx] = true	<-- UNCOVERED
160	            out[nidx] = b'\xFF'
161	            stack.push(nidx)	<-- UNCOVERED
162	          }
163	        }
164	      }
165	    }
166	  }
167	  @types.Image::{
168	    width: w,
169	    height: h,
170	    channels: 1,
171	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),
172	  }
173	}

168	      let gy = -blurred[(y - 1) * w + (x - 1)] -

199	      }

201	      let (n1, n2) = match dir {	<-- UNCOVERED

204	        2 => (gradient[(y - 1) * w + x], gradient[(y + 1) * w + x])

264	pub fn canny_edge_f(

287	    )

297	    )

301	  }

318	      let b = read_float_le_c(img.data, i * bpp + 8)

320	    }
321	  }
322	  // 1. 高斯模糊 (5x5, sigma=1.0)
323	  let blurred : Array[Float] = Array::make(n, 0.0F)
324	  let kernel : Array[Float] = [
325	    2.0F, 4.0F, 5.0F, 4.0F, 2.0F, 4.0F, 9.0F, 12.0F, 9.0F, 4.0F, 5.0F, 12.0F, 15.0F,
326	    12.0F, 5.0F, 4.0F, 9.0F, 12.0F, 9.0F, 4.0F, 2.0F, 4.0F, 5.0F, 4.0F, 2.0F,

335	        let krow = ky * 5
336	        for kx in 0..<5 {

338	        }
339	      }

341	    }
342	  }

347	        continue

349	      let mut sum = 0.0F
350	      for ky in 0..<5 {

353	          let py = clamp_int_c(y + ky - 2, 0, h - 1)
354	          sum += gray[py * w + px] * kernel[ky * 5 + kx]
355	        }
356	      }
357	      blurred[y * w + x] = sum / kernel_sum
358	    }

382	      direction[idx] = if norm_angle < 22.5F || norm_angle >= 157.5F {

384	      } else if norm_angle < 67.5F {	<-- UNCOVERED

191	pub fn contour_perimeter(contour : Contour) -> Float {
192	  let pts = contour.points

30	pub fn convex_hull(points : Array[ContourPoint]) -> Array[ContourPoint] {
31	  // 空数组返回空数组
32	  if points.length() == 0 {
33	    return []	<-- UNCOVERED
34	  }
35	
36	  let n = points.length()
37	  if n <= 2 {
38	    let out : Array[ContourPoint] = []	<-- UNCOVERED
39	    for p in points {
40	      out.push(p)	<-- UNCOVERED
41	    }
42	    return out
43	  }
44	  // 找最下方的点（y 最大，x 最小）
45	  let mut pivot = 0
46	  for i in 1..<n {
47	    if points[i].y > points[pivot].y ||
48	      (points[i].y == points[pivot].y && points[i].x < points[pivot].x) {
49	      pivot = i
50	    }
51	  }
52	  // 按极角排序
53	  let p0 = points[pivot]
54	  let sorted : Array[ContourPoint] = []
55	  for i in 0..<n {
56	    if i != pivot {
57	      sorted.push(points[i])
58	    }
59	  }
60	  sorted.sort_by(fn(a, b) {
61	    let cross = (a.x - p0.x) * (b.y - p0.y) - (a.y - p0.y) * (b.x - p0.x)
62	    (0 - cross).compare(0)
63	  })
64	  // Graham 扫描
65	  let hull : Array[ContourPoint] = [p0]
66	  for p in sorted {
67	    while hull.length() >= 2 {
68	      let m = hull.length()
69	      let p1 = hull[m - 2]
70	      let p2 = hull[m - 1]
71	      let cross = (p2.x - p1.x) * (p.y - p1.y) - (p2.y - p1.y) * (p.x - p1.x)
72	      if cross <= 0 {
73	        ignore(hull.pop())
74	      } else {
75	        break
76	      }
77	    }
78	    hull.push(p)
79	  }

126	fn approx_dp_recursive(
127	  points : Array[ContourPoint],
128	  start : Int,
129	  end : Int,
130	  epsilon : Float,
131	  keep : Array[Bool],
132	) -> Unit {
133	  let n = points.length()
134	  let mut max_dist = 0.0F
135	  let mut max_idx = -1
136	  let p_start = points[start]
137	  let p_end = points[end]
138	  let dx = Float::from_int(p_end.x - p_start.x)
139	  let dy = Float::from_int(p_end.y - p_start.y)
140	  let len_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy
141	  let mut i = (start + 1) % n
142	  while i != end {
143	    let p = points[i]
144	    let px = Float::from_int(p.x - p_start.x)
145	    let py = Float::from_int(p.y - p_start.y)
146	    let dist = if len_sq == 0.0F {
147	      (px * px + py * py).sqrt()
148	    } else {
149	      let t = (px * dx + py * dy) / len_sq
150	      let proj_x = t * dx
151	      let proj_y = t * dy
152	      ((px - proj_x) * (px - proj_x) + (py - proj_y) * (py - proj_y)).sqrt()
153	    }
154	    if dist > max_dist {
155	      max_dist = dist
156	      max_idx = i
157	    }
158	    i = (i + 1) % n
159	    if i == start {
160	      break	<-- UNCOVERED
161	    }
162	  }
163	  if max_idx >= 0 && max_dist > epsilon {
164	    keep[max_idx] = true
165	    approx_dp_recursive(points, start, max_idx, epsilon, keep)
166	    approx_dp_recursive(points, max_idx, end, epsilon, keep)
167	  }
168	}

 28	    )

 32	  let h = img.height
 33	  let ch = img.channels
 34	  let n = w * h
 35	  // 先转灰度
 36	  let gray : Array[Int] = Array::make(n, 0)
 37	  for i in 0..<n {
 38	    if ch == 1 {
 39	      gray[i] = img.data[i].to_int()
 40	    } else {
 41	      let r = img.data[i * ch].to_int()
 42	      let g = img.data[i * ch + 1].to_int()
 43	      let b = img.data[i * ch + 2].to_int()
 44	      gray[i] = (r * 299 + g * 587 + b * 114) / 1000
 45	    }
 46	  }
 47	  // Sobel 卷积
 48	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(n, b'\x00')
 49	  // 内部区域：1 <= x < w-1 && 1 <= y < h-1，无需 clamp

 51	    for x in 1..<(w - 1) {

 53	      let idx_l = idx - 1
 54	      let idx_r = idx + 1
 55	      let idx_t = idx - w
 56	      let idx_b = idx + w
 57	      // Gx = [-1 0 1; -2 0 2; -1 0 1]
 58	      let gx = -gray[idx_t - 1] +
 59	        gray[idx_t + 1] -
 60	        2 * gray[idx_l] +
 61	        2 * gray[idx_r] -
 62	        gray[idx_b - 1] +
 63	        gray[idx_b + 1]
 64	      // Gy = [-1 -2 -1; 0 0 0; 1 2 1]
 65	      let gy = -gray[idx_t - 1] -
 66	        2 * gray[idx_t] -
 67	        gray[idx_t + 1] +
 68	        gray[idx_b - 1] +
 69	        2 * gray[idx_b] +
 70	        gray[idx_b + 1]

 72	      out[idx] = (mag + 0.5F).to_int().clamp(min=0, max=255).to_byte()
 73	    }

179	      let right = clamp_i(x + 1, 0, w - 1)
180	      let center = gray[cy * w + cx]
181	      let u = gray[up * w + cx]
182	      let d = gray[down * w + cx]
183	      let l = gray[cy * w + left]

186	      out[y * w + x] = clamp_b(lap.abs())
187	    }

 38	      img.data.length().to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
 39	    )
 40	  }
 41	  if threshold <= 0 {
 42	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("hough_lines: threshold必须大于0")	<-- UNCOVERED
 43	  }
 44	  if theta_resolution <= 0.0F {
 45	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
 46	      "hough_lines: theta_resolution必须大于0",
 47	    )
 48	  }
 49	  if rho_resolution <= 0.0F {
 50	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
 51	      "hough_lines: rho_resolution必须大于0",
 52	    )
 53	  }
 54	  let w = img.width
 55	  let h = img.height
 56	  let ch = img.channels
 57	  // 角度范围 0~180 度
 58	  let n_theta = (180.0F / theta_resolution).to_int()
 59	  let diag = Float::from_int(w * w + h * h).sqrt()
 60	  let max_rho = (diag / rho_resolution).to_int() + 1
 61	  let n_rho = 2 * max_rho + 1
 62	  // 累加器（一维数组，提高缓存友好性）
 63	  let accumulator : Array[Int] = Array::make(n_rho * n_theta, 0)
 64	  // 预计算 sin/cos 表
 65	  let cos_table : Array[Float] = Array::make(n_theta, 0.0F)
 66	  let sin_table : Array[Float] = Array::make(n_theta, 0.0F)
 67	  let angle_scale = theta_resolution * 3.141592653589793F / 180.0F
 68	  for t in 0..<n_theta {
 69	    let angle = Float::from_int(t) * angle_scale
 70	    cos_table[t] = @math.cosf(angle)
 71	    sin_table[t] = @math.sinf(angle)
 72	  }
 73	  // 预计算 1/rho_resolution，用乘法替代除法
 74	  let inv_rho_res = 1.0F / rho_resolution
 75	  let rho_max_idx = n_rho - 1
 76	  // 预计算首通道 to_int（只看第一个通道判断边缘）
 77	  let data_int : Array[Int] = Array::make(w * h, 0)
 78	  for i in 0..<(w * h) {

 80	  }

 82	  for y in 0..<h {
 83	    let fy = Float::from_int(y)
 84	    let row_base = y * w
 85	    for x in 0..<w {
 86	      if data_int[row_base + x] == 0 {
 87	        continue
 88	      }
 89	      let fx = Float::from_int(x)
 90	      for t in 0..<n_theta {
 91	        let rho = fx * cos_table[t] + fy * sin_table[t]
 92	        let raw_idx = (rho * inv_rho_res).to_int() + max_rho
 93	        // 内联 clamp，避免方法调用开销
 94	        let rho_idx = if raw_idx < 0 {
 95	          0	<-- UNCOVERED
 96	        } else if raw_idx > rho_max_idx {
 97	          rho_max_idx	<-- UNCOVERED
 98	        } else {
 99	          raw_idx
100	        }
101	        accumulator[rho_idx * n_theta + t] += 1
102	      }
103	    }
104	  }
105	  // 收集结果
106	  let lines : Array[HoughLine] = []
107	  let max_rho_f = Float::from_int(max_rho)
108	  for r in 0..<n_rho {
109	    let row_base = r * n_theta
110	    for t in 0..<n_theta {
111	      let votes = accumulator[row_base + t]
112	      if votes >= threshold {
113	        lines.push(HoughLine::{
114	          rho: (Float::from_int(r) - max_rho_f) * rho_resolution,
115	          theta: Float::from_int(t) * angle_scale,
116	          votes,
117	        })
118	      }
119	    }
120	  }
121	  // 按票数降序排序
122	  lines.sort_by(fn(a, b) { b.votes - a.votes })
123	  lines

297	      }

302	        let cy_neg = y - (dy * Float::from_int(r) / mag_sqrt).to_int()

179	  img : @types.Image,

212	        }

226	    }

230	    sum_x2 += pixel1 * pixel1
231	    sum_y2 += pixel2 * pixel2
232	    count += 1
233	  }

236	  }

169	        }

187	pub fn tone_mapping_reinhard(
188	  img : @types.Image,
189	  key? : Double = 0.18,
190	) -> @types.Image raise @types.LoadError {
191	  // 输入验证
192	  if img.width <= 0 || img.height <= 0 {
193	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
194	      "tone_mapping_reinhard: 图像尺寸必须大于0",
195	    )
196	  }
197	  if img.channels < 1 || img.channels > 4 {
198	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
199	      "tone_mapping_reinhard: 通道数必须在1-4之间",
200	    )
201	  }
202	  let expected_size = img.width * img.height * img.channels
203	  if img.data.length() != expected_size {
204	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
205	      "tone_mapping_reinhard: 数据大小不匹配，期望 " +
206	      expected_size.to_string() +	<-- UNCOVERED
207	      "，实际 " +
208	      img.data.length().to_string(),	<-- UNCOVERED
209	    )
210	  }
211	  if key <= 0.0 {
212	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(	<-- UNCOVERED
213	      "tone_mapping_reinhard: key必须大于0",
214	    )
215	  }
216	
217	  let k = key
218	  let w = img.width
219	  let h = img.height
220	  let channels = img.channels
221	  let data = img.data
222	  // 计算对数平均亮度
223	  let mut log_sum = 0.0
224	  let delta = 0.0001
225	  for i in 0..<(w * h) {
226	    let idx = i * channels
227	    let r = data[idx].to_double() / 255.0
228	    let g = if channels >= 2 { data[idx + 1].to_double() / 255.0 } else { r }
229	    let b = if channels >= 3 { data[idx + 2].to_double() / 255.0 } else { r }
230	    let luminance = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b
231	    log_sum += @math.ln(luminance + delta)
232	  }
233	  let log_avg = @math.exp(log_sum / (w * h).to_double())
234	  // 应用 Reinhard 色调映射
235	  let out_data : Array[Byte] = Array::make(w * h * channels, b'\x00')
236	  for i in 0..<(w * h) {
237	    let idx = i * channels
238	    for c in 0..<channels {
239	      let val = data[idx + c].to_double() / 255.0
240	      // 缩放
241	      let scaled = val * k / (log_avg + delta)
242	      // Reinhard 映射
243	      let mapped = scaled / (1.0 + scaled)
244	      out_data[idx + c] = (mapped * 255.0)
245	        .min(255.0)
246	        .max(0.0)
247	        .to_int()
248	        .to_byte()
249	    }
250	  }
251	  @types.Image::{
252	    width: w,
253	    height: h,
254	    channels,
255	    data: Bytes::from_array(out_data),
256	  }
257	}

502	pub fn estimate_age_gender(
503	  img : @types.Image,
504	  face : FaceDetectionResult,
505	) -> AgeGenderEstimationResult {
506	  let w = img.width
507	  let h = img.height
508	
509	  // 简化版：基于人脸区域的纹理和皱纹估计年龄
510	  // 实际实现应该使用深度学习模型
511	
512	  let bx = face.bounding_box[0].to_int()
513	  let by = face.bounding_box[1].to_int()
514	  let bw = face.bounding_box[2].to_int()
515	  let bh = face.bounding_box[3].to_int()
516	
517	  // 计算人脸区域的纹理复杂度（简化的年龄估计）
518	  let mut texture_complexity = 0.0
519	  let mut count = 0
520	  for y in 1..<(bh - 1) {
521	    for x in 1..<(bw - 1) {
522	      let px = bx + x
523	      let py = by + y
524	      if px >= 1 && px < w - 1 && py >= 1 && py < h - 1 {

527	        let gy = img.data[idx + w].to_double() - img.data[idx - w].to_double()
528	        texture_complexity += (gx * gx + gy * gy).sqrt()
529	        count += 1
530	      }
531	    }
532	  }
533	  texture_complexity = if count > 0 {
534	    texture_complexity / count.to_double()
535	  } else {
536	    0.0	<-- UNCOVERED
537	  }
538	
539	  // 简化的年龄估计（纹理越复杂，年龄越大）
540	  let age = 20.0 + texture_complexity * 2.0
541	  let age_range = [age - 5.0, age + 5.0]
542	
543	  // 简化的性别判断（基于人脸区域的亮度和形状）
544	  let is_male = texture_complexity > 10.0
545	  let gender = if is_male { "male" } else { "female" }
546	  let gender_confidence = 0.6
547	
548	  AgeGenderEstimationResult::{
549	    age,
550	    age_range,
551	    gender,
552	    gender_confidence,
553	    is_male,
554	  }

559	pub fn evaluate_face_quality(
560	  img : @types.Image,
561	  face : FaceDetectionResult,
562	) -> Double {
563	  let w = img.width
564	  let h = img.height
565	
566	  let bx = face.bounding_box[0].to_int()
567	  let by = face.bounding_box[1].to_int()
568	  let bw = face.bounding_box[2].to_int()
569	  let bh = face.bounding_box[3].to_int()
570	
571	  // 计算亮度
572	  let mut brightness = 0.0
573	  let mut sharpness = 0.0
574	  let mut count = 0
575	  for y in 1..<(bh - 1) {
576	    for x in 1..<(bw - 1) {
577	      let px = bx + x
578	      let py = by + y
579	      if px >= 1 && px < w - 1 && py >= 1 && py < h - 1 {
580	        let idx = py * w + px
581	        brightness += img.data[idx].to_double()
582	        let gx = img.data[idx + 1].to_double() - img.data[idx - 1].to_double()
583	        let gy = img.data[idx + w].to_double() - img.data[idx - w].to_double()
584	        sharpness += (gx * gx + gy * gy).sqrt()
585	        count += 1
586	      }
587	    }
588	  }
589	
590	  brightness = if count > 0 { brightness / count.to_double() } else { 0.0 }
591	  sharpness = if count > 0 { sharpness / count.to_double() } else { 0.0 }
592	
593	  // 综合质量评分（亮度 40% + 锐度 60%）
594	  let brightness_score = if brightness > 80.0 && brightness < 180.0 {
595	    1.0
596	  } else {
597	    0.5	<-- UNCOVERED
598	  }
599	  let sharpness_score = if sharpness > 20.0 {
600	    1.0	<-- UNCOVERED
601	  } else if sharpness > 10.0 {
602	    0.7	<-- UNCOVERED
603	  } else {
604	    0.4
605	  }
606	
607	  brightness_score * 0.4 + sharpness_score * 0.6
608	}

 41	  }

 48	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("sigma 必须 > 0")

 52	  }

 55	  let h = img.height

 57	  if n == 0 {
 58	    return img	<-- UNCOVERED
 59	  }
 60	  // 生成 Gabor 核
 61	  let half = ksize / 2
 62	  let kernel : Array[Float] = Array::make(ksize * ksize, 0.0F)
 63	  let cos_t = @math.cosf(theta)
 64	  let sin_t = @math.sinf(theta)
 65	  for ky in 0..<ksize {
 66	    for kx in 0..<ksize {
 67	      let x = Float::from_int(kx - half)
 68	      let y = Float::from_int(ky - half)
 69	      let x_prime = x * cos_t + y * sin_t
 70	      let y_prime = -x * sin_t + y * cos_t
 71	      let gaussian = @math.expf(
 72	        -(x_prime * x_prime + gamma * gamma * y_prime * y_prime) /
 73	        (2.0F * sigma * sigma),
 74	      )
 75	      let wave = @math.cosf(2.0F * 3.14159265F * x_prime / lambda + phi)
 76	      let val = gaussian * wave
 77	      kernel[ky * ksize + kx] = val
 78	    }
 79	  }

 82	  for i in 0..<(n * ch) {
 83	    src[i] = Float::from_int(img.data[i].to_int())
 84	  }
 85	  // 卷积，分离内部/边界区域，ch=1 特化消除内层通道循环

 98	          }
 99	        }
100	        let val = sum.to_int()
101	        out[y * w + x] = val.clamp(min=0, max=255).to_byte()
102	      }
103	    }

105	    for y in 0..<h {

107	      for x in 0..<w {

109	          continue
110	        }
111	        let mut sum = 0.0F
112	        for ky in 0..<ksize {
113	          for kx in 0..<ksize {
114	            let px = (x + kx - half).clamp(min=0, max=w - 1)
115	            let py = (y + ky - half).clamp(min=0, max=h - 1)
116	            sum += src[py * w + px] * kernel[ky * ksize + kx]
117	          }
118	        }

120	        out[y * w + x] = val.clamp(min=0, max=255).to_byte()
121	      }
122	    }
123	  } else {

128	        }

130	      }
131	      // 内部区域
132	      for y in half..<(h - half) {
133	        for x in half..<(w - half) {
134	          let mut sum = 0.0F
135	          let base = (y - half) * w + (x - half)
136	          for ky in 0..<ksize {
137	            let row = (base + ky * w) * ch + c
138	            let krow = ky * ksize
139	            for kx in 0..<ksize {
140	              sum += src[row + kx * ch] * kernel[krow + kx]
141	            }
142	          }
143	          let val = sum.to_int()

145	        }
146	      }
147	      // 边界区域
148	      for y in 0..<h {

150	        for x in 0..<w {
151	          if y_inner && x >= half && x < w - half {
