1332	  y : Int,
1333	  width : Int,
1334	  height : Int,
1335	) -> Int {
1336	  let cx = if x < 0 { 0 } else if x >= width { width - 1 } else { x }	<-- UNCOVERED
1337	  let cy = if y < 0 { 0 } else if y >= height { height - 1 } else { y }
1338	  ref_plane[cy * width + cx]
1339	}

1344	fn vp8_interpolate_subpixel(
1345	  ref_plane : Array[Int],
1346	  base_x : Int,
1347	  base_y : Int,
1348	  mv_x_q4 : Int,
1349	  mv_y_q4 : Int,
1350	  width : Int,
1351	  height : Int,
1352	) -> Int {
1353	  // 整数部分和小数部分
1354	  let int_x = mv_x_q4 >> 2	<-- UNCOVERED
1355	  let frac_x = mv_x_q4 & 3
1356	  let int_y = mv_y_q4 >> 2
1357	  let frac_y = mv_y_q4 & 3
1358	
1359	  let px = base_x + int_x
1360	  let py = base_y + int_y
1361	
1362	  // 如果是整数像素，直接返回
1363	  if frac_x == 0 && frac_y == 0 {
1364	    return vp8_get_ref_pixel(ref_plane, px, py, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
1365	  }
1366	
1367	  // 半像素插值（使用 6 抽头滤波器）
1368	  // 先进行水平插值得到半像素
1369	  let h_samples : Array[Int] = Array::make(6, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
1370	  for i in 0..<6 {
1371	    h_samples[i] = vp8_get_ref_pixel(ref_plane, px - 2 + i, py, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
1372	  }
1373	  let half_x = if frac_x >= 2 {
1374	    vp8_interpolate_6tap(	<-- UNCOVERED
1375	      h_samples[0],
1376	      h_samples[1],
1377	      h_samples[2],
1378	      h_samples[3],
1379	      h_samples[4],
1380	      h_samples[5],
1381	    )
1382	  } else {
1383	    h_samples[2]	<-- UNCOVERED
1384	  }
1385	
1386	  // 进行垂直插值得到半像素
1387	  let v_samples : Array[Int] = Array::make(6, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
1388	  for i in 0..<6 {
1389	    v_samples[i] = vp8_get_ref_pixel(ref_plane, px, py - 2 + i, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
1390	  }
1391	  let half_y = if frac_y >= 2 {
1392	    vp8_interpolate_6tap(	<-- UNCOVERED
1393	      v_samples[0],
1394	      v_samples[1],
1395	      v_samples[2],
1396	      v_samples[3],
1397	      v_samples[4],
1398	      v_samples[5],
1399	    )
1400	  } else {
1401	    v_samples[2]	<-- UNCOVERED
1402	  }
1403	
1404	  // 双线性插值（四分之一像素）
1405	  if frac_x == 0 {
1406	    // 只有垂直偏移
1407	    let t = frac_y	<-- UNCOVERED
1408	    return (half_x * (4 - t) + half_y * t + 2) >> 2
1409	  }
1410	  if frac_y == 0 {
1411	    // 只有水平偏移
1412	    let t = frac_x	<-- UNCOVERED
1413	    return (half_y * (4 - t) + half_x * t + 2) >> 2
1414	  }
1415	  // 双向偏移：使用四个角的双线性插值
1416	  let h00 = vp8_get_ref_pixel(ref_plane, px, py, width, height)	<-- UNCOVERED
1417	  let h10 = half_x
1418	  let h01 = half_y
1419	  // 计算对角半像素（先水平后垂直，或先垂直后水平，取平均）
1420	  let diag_samples_h : Array[Int] = Array::make(6, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
1421	  for i in 0..<6 {
1422	    diag_samples_h[i] = vp8_get_ref_pixel(	<-- UNCOVERED
1423	      ref_plane,
1424	      px - 2 + i,
1425	      py + 1,
1426	      width,
1427	      height,
1428	    )
1429	  }
1430	  let h11 = vp8_interpolate_6tap(	<-- UNCOVERED
1431	    diag_samples_h[0],
1432	    diag_samples_h[1],
1433	    diag_samples_h[2],
1434	    diag_samples_h[3],
1435	    diag_samples_h[4],
1436	    diag_samples_h[5],
1437	  )
1438	
1439	  let tx = frac_x
1440	  let ty = frac_y
1441	  let a = h00 * (4 - tx) * (4 - ty)
1442	  let b = h10 * tx * (4 - ty)
1443	  let c = h01 * (4 - tx) * ty
1444	  let d = h11 * tx * ty
1445	  (a + b + c + d + 8) >> 4
1446	}
    	…

1451	fn vp8_motion_compensate_16x4_subpixel(
1452	  ref_y : Array[Int],
1453	  ref_u : Array[Int],
1454	  ref_v : Array[Int],
1455	  mb_x : Int,
1456	  mb_y : Int,
1457	  mv_x_q4 : Int,
1458	  mv_y_q4 : Int,
1459	  width : Int,
1460	  height : Int,
1461	) -> (Array[Int], Array[Int], Array[Int]) {
1462	  let pred_y = Array::make(256, 128)	<-- UNCOVERED
1463	  let pred_u = Array::make(64, 128)
1464	  let pred_v = Array::make(64, 128)
1465	
1466	  // Y 平面：16x16，1/4 像素精度
1467	  for y in 0..<16 {
1468	    for x in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1469	      pred_y[y * 16 + x] = vp8_interpolate_subpixel(
1470	        ref_y,
1471	        mb_x * 16 + x,
1472	        mb_y * 16 + y,
1473	        mv_x_q4,
1474	        mv_y_q4,
1475	        width,
1476	        height,
1477	      )
1478	    }
1479	  }
1480	
1481	  // U/V 平面：8x8，运动向量减半（1/4 像素 → 1/2 像素）
1482	  let uv_width = width / 2
1483	  let uv_height = height / 2
1484	  let uv_mv_x_q4 = mv_x_q4 / 2
1485	  let uv_mv_y_q4 = mv_y_q4 / 2
1486	  for y in 0..<8 {
1487	    for x in 0..<8 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1488	      pred_u[y * 8 + x] = vp8_interpolate_subpixel(
1489	        ref_u,
1490	        mb_x * 8 + x,
1491	        mb_y * 8 + y,
1492	        uv_mv_x_q4,
1493	        uv_mv_y_q4,
1494	        uv_width,
1495	        uv_height,
1496	      )
1497	      pred_v[y * 8 + x] = vp8_interpolate_subpixel(	<-- UNCOVERED
1498	        ref_v,
1499	        mb_x * 8 + x,
1500	        mb_y * 8 + y,
1501	        uv_mv_x_q4,
1502	        uv_mv_y_q4,
1503	        uv_width,
1504	        uv_height,
1505	      )
1506	    }
1507	  }
1508	
1509	  (pred_y, pred_u, pred_v)
1510	}
    	…

1515	fn vp8_read_ue_golomb(bd : Vp8BoolDecoder) -> Int {
1516	  let mut leading_zeros = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1517	  while bd.read_bool(128) == 0 {
1518	    leading_zeros += 1
1519	    if leading_zeros > 31 {
1520	      return 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1521	    }
1522	  }
1523	  if leading_zeros == 0 {
1524	    return 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1525	  }
1526	  let mut value = 1
1527	  for _ in 0..<leading_zeros {
1528	    value = (value << 1) | bd.read_bool(128)	<-- UNCOVERED
1529	  }
1530	  value - 1
1531	}
    	…

1535	fn vp8_read_se_golomb(bd : Vp8BoolDecoder) -> Int {
1536	  let value = vp8_read_ue_golomb(bd)	<-- UNCOVERED
1537	  if value == 0 {
1538	    return 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1539	  }
1540	  if value % 2 == 1 {
1541	    (value + 1) / 2	<-- UNCOVERED
1542	  } else {
1543	    -(value / 2)	<-- UNCOVERED
1544	  }
1545	}
    	…

1550	fn vp8_parse_mv_residual(bd : Vp8BoolDecoder, prob : Int) -> Int {
1551	  ignore(prob)	<-- UNCOVERED
1552	  // 简化实现：使用 Exp-Golomb 编码
1553	  // 完整 VP8 使用更复杂的运动向量残差编码
1554	  let residual = vp8_read_se_golomb(bd)	<-- UNCOVERED
1555	  residual * 4 // 转换为 1/4 像素单位
1556	}
    	…

1569	fn vp8_parse_ref_frame(bd : Vp8BoolDecoder, ref_prob : Int) -> Vp8RefFrame {
1570	  // 简化实现：使用概率选择参考帧
1571	  let is_last = bd.read_bool(ref_prob) == 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1572	  if is_last {
1573	    return Vp8RefFrame::RefLast	<-- UNCOVERED
1574	  }
1575	  let is_golden = bd.read_bool(128) == 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1576	  if is_golden {
1577	    Vp8RefFrame::RefGolden	<-- UNCOVERED
1578	  } else {
1579	    Vp8RefFrame::RefAltref	<-- UNCOVERED
1580	  }
1581	}
    	…

1585	fn vp8_get_ref_planes(
1586	  refs : Vp8ReferenceFrames,
1587	  ref_frame : Vp8RefFrame,
1588	) -> (Array[Int], Array[Int], Array[Int]) {
1589	  match ref_frame {	<-- UNCOVERED
1590	    Vp8RefFrame::RefLast => (refs.last_y, refs.last_u, refs.last_v)
1591	    Vp8RefFrame::RefGolden => (refs.golden_y, refs.golden_u, refs.golden_v)
1592	    Vp8RefFrame::RefAltref => (refs.altref_y, refs.altref_u, refs.altref_v)
1593	  }
1594	}
    	…

1599	fn vp8_parse_full_motion_vector(
1600	  bd : Vp8BoolDecoder,
1601	  pred_mv : Vp8MotionVector,
1602	  mv_prob : Int,
1603	) -> (Int, Int) {
1604	  // 解析是否使用预测运动向量
1605	  let use_pred = bd.read_bool(mv_prob) == 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1606	  if use_pred {
1607	    return (pred_mv.mv_x * 4, pred_mv.mv_y * 4)	<-- UNCOVERED
1608	  }
1609	  // 解析运动向量残差
1610	  let dx = vp8_parse_mv_residual(bd, 128)	<-- UNCOVERED
1611	  let dy = vp8_parse_mv_residual(bd, 128)
1612	  (pred_mv.mv_x * 4 + dx, pred_mv.mv_y * 4 + dy)
1613	}
    	…

1617	fn vp8_predict_motion_vector(
1618	  left_mv : Vp8MotionVector,
1619	  above_mv : Vp8MotionVector,
1620	  above_left_mv : Vp8MotionVector,
1621	) -> Vp8MotionVector {
1622	  let pred = Vp8MotionVector::new()	<-- UNCOVERED
1623	  // 中值预测
1624	  let xs = [left_mv.mv_x, above_mv.mv_x, above_left_mv.mv_x]
1625	  let ys = [left_mv.mv_y, above_mv.mv_y, above_left_mv.mv_y]
1626	  // 简单排序取中值
1627	  let mut x_median = xs[0]
1628	  if (xs[1] - xs[0]) * (xs[2] - xs[0]) <= 0 {
1629	    x_median = xs[0]	<-- UNCOVERED
1630	  } else if (xs[0] - xs[1]) * (xs[2] - xs[1]) <= 0 {
1631	    x_median = xs[1]
1632	  } else {
1633	    x_median = xs[2]	<-- UNCOVERED
1634	  }
1635	  let mut y_median = ys[0]
1636	  if (ys[1] - ys[0]) * (ys[2] - ys[0]) <= 0 {
1637	    y_median = ys[0]	<-- UNCOVERED
1638	  } else if (ys[0] - ys[1]) * (ys[2] - ys[1]) <= 0 {
1639	    y_median = ys[1]
1640	  } else {
1641	    y_median = ys[2]	<-- UNCOVERED
1642	  }
1643	  pred.mv_x = x_median
1644	  pred.mv_y = y_median
1645	  pred
1646	}
    	…

1652	pub fn decode_vp8_frame(
1653	  data : Bytes,
1654	  offset : Int,
1655	) -> @types.Image raise @types.LoadError {
1656	  let br = Vp8BitReader::new(data, offset)
1657	  let header = parse_vp8_frame_header(br)
1658	
1659	  if !header.key_frame {
1660	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("VP8 非关键帧暂不支持")	<-- UNCOVERED
1661	  }
1662	
1663	  if header.width == 0 || header.height == 0 {
1664	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("VP8 帧尺寸无效")
1665	  }
1666	
1667	  let w = header.width
1668	  let h = header.height
1669	
1670	  // 解析量化参数
1671	  let quant = parse_quantization(br)	<-- UNCOVERED
1672	
1673	  // 解析 segment 参数
1674	  let segment = parse_segmentation(br)	<-- UNCOVERED
1675	
1676	  // 简化实现：创建一个纯色图像（灰色）
1677	  // 完整的 VP8 解码需要解析残差系数、进行 IDCT、帧内预测等
1678	  // 这里先实现基础框架，后续迭代完善
1679	  let base_y = 128 - quant.y_dc / 4
1680	  let base_u = 128 - quant.uv_ac / 4
1681	  let base_v = 128 - quant.uv_dc / 4
1682	  let y_plane : Array[Int] = Array::make(w * h, base_y)	<-- UNCOVERED
1683	  let u_plane : Array[Int] = Array::make(w / 2 * (h / 2), base_u)
1684	  let v_plane : Array[Int] = Array::make(w / 2 * (h / 2), base_v)
1685	
1686	  // 帧内预测 + 残差系数解析 + IDCT 反变换
1687	  // 创建布尔解码器用于残差系数解析和预测模式解析
1688	  let bd = Vp8BoolDecoder::new(data, offset + 10)	<-- UNCOVERED
1689	  let coeff_probs = Vp8AdaptiveProbs::new()
1690	  let mb_mode_probs = Vp8MbModeProbs::new()
1691	
1692	  // 对每个 16x16 宏块：解析预测模式 + 残差解析
1693	  let mb_w = (w + 15) / 16
1694	  let mb_h = (h + 15) / 16
1695	  // 保存每个宏块的 segment ID（用于环路滤波）
1696	  let segment_id_map : Array[Int] = Array::make(mb_w * mb_h, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
1697	  for mb_y in 0..<mb_h {
1698	    for mb_x in 0..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
1699	      // 解析宏块的 segment ID
1700	      let segment_id = if segment.enabled && segment.update_map {	<-- UNCOVERED
1701	        vp8_parse_mb_segment_id(bd, segment.mb_segment_tree_probs)
1702	      } else {
1703	        0	<-- UNCOVERED
1704	      }
1705	      segment_id_map[mb_y * mb_w + mb_x] = segment_id
1706	
1707	      // 根据 segment ID 计算实际量化参数
1708	      let _ = vp8_get_quant_for_segment(quant, segment, segment_id)	<-- UNCOVERED
1709	
1710	      // 生成参考像素
1711	      let above : Array[Int] = Array::make(16, 128)	<-- UNCOVERED
1712	      let left : Array[Int] = Array::make(16, 128)
1713	      let above_left = 128
1714	
1715	      // 从 bitstream 解析 I16x16 预测模式（使用自适应概率模型）
1716	      let mode = vp8_parse_i16x16_mode(bd, mb_mode_probs)	<-- UNCOVERED
1717	
1718	      // 解析色度预测模式（UV 平面）
1719	      let uv_mode = vp8_parse_uv_mode(bd, mb_mode_probs)	<-- UNCOVERED
1720	      ignore(uv_mode) // 色度预测暂未完全实现，UV 平面使用基础值
1721	
1722	      let pred = vp8_intra_predict_16x16(mode, above, left, above_left)	<-- UNCOVERED
1723	
1724	      // 解析 DC 系数（16x16 块的 DC 系数组成 4x4 块）
1725	      let dc_coeffs = vp8_parse_dc_coeffs_16x16(bd, coeff_probs)	<-- UNCOVERED
1726	      let dc_residual = vp8_wht_4x4(dc_coeffs)
1727	
1728	      // 对每个 4x4 子块解析 AC 系数并进行 IDCT
1729	      for sub_y in 0..<4 {
1730	        for sub_x in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1731	          // 解析 AC 系数
1732	          let ac_coeffs = vp8_parse_residual_4x4(bd, coeff_probs, false)	<-- UNCOVERED
1733	          // 将 DC 系数添加到 AC 系数中
1734	          ac_coeffs[0] = ac_coeffs[0] + dc_residual[sub_y * 4 + sub_x]
1735	          // IDCT 反变换
1736	          let residual = vp8_idct_4x4(ac_coeffs)	<-- UNCOVERED
1737	          // 将预测和残差相加
1738	          for y in 0..<4 {
1739	            for x in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1740	              let px = mb_x * 16 + sub_x * 4 + x
1741	              let py = mb_y * 16 + sub_y * 4 + y
1742	              if px < w && py < h {
1743	                let pred_y = sub_y * 4 + y	<-- UNCOVERED
1744	                let pred_x = sub_x * 4 + x
1745	                let mut val = pred[pred_y * 16 + pred_x] + residual[y * 4 + x]
1746	                if val < 0 {
1747	                  val = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1748	                }
1749	                if val > 255 {
1750	                  val = 255	<-- UNCOVERED
1751	                }
1752	                y_plane[py * w + px] = val
1753	              }
1754	            }
1755	          }
1756	        }
1757	      }
1758	      // 更新宏块预测模式概率（EMA）
1759	      mb_mode_probs.update()	<-- UNCOVERED
1760	    }
1761	  }
1762	
1763	  // 环路滤波（基于 segment 的自适应滤波强度）
1764	  let base_filter_level = quant.y_ac / 4
1765	  for mb_y in 0..<mb_h {
1766	    for mb_x in 0..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
1767	      let segment_id = segment_id_map[mb_y * mb_w + mb_x]
1768	      let mb_filter_level = vp8_get_filter_level_for_segment(
1769	        base_filter_level, segment, segment_id,
1770	      )
1771	      vp8_loop_filter_mb(	<-- UNCOVERED
1772	        y_plane, u_plane, v_plane, mb_x, mb_y, w, h, mb_filter_level,
1773	      )
1774	    }
1775	  }
1776	
1777	  // YUV420 转 RGB
1778	  let out : Array[Byte] = Array::make(w * h * 3, b'\x00')	<-- UNCOVERED
1779	  for y in 0..<h {
1780	    for x in 0..<w {	<-- UNCOVERED
1781	      let y_val = y_plane[y * w + x]
1782	      let u_val = u_plane[y / 2 * (w / 2) + x / 2]
1783	      let v_val = v_plane[y / 2 * (w / 2) + x / 2]
1784	
1785	      // YUV 转 RGB（简化）
1786	      let c = y_val - 16
1787	      let d = u_val - 128
1788	      let e = v_val - 128
1789	
1790	      let mut r = (298 * c + 409 * e + 128) >> 8
1791	      let mut g = (298 * c - 100 * d - 208 * e + 128) >> 8
1792	      let mut b = (298 * c + 516 * d + 128) >> 8
1793	
1794	      if r < 0 {
1795	        r = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1796	      }
1797	      if r > 255 {
1798	        r = 255	<-- UNCOVERED
1799	      }
1800	      if g < 0 {
1801	        g = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1802	      }
1803	      if g > 255 {
1804	        g = 255	<-- UNCOVERED
1805	      }
1806	      if b < 0 {
1807	        b = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1808	      }
1809	      if b > 255 {
1810	        b = 255	<-- UNCOVERED
1811	      }
1812	
1813	      let idx = (y * w + x) * 3
1814	      out[idx] = r.to_byte()	<-- UNCOVERED
1815	      out[idx + 1] = g.to_byte()
1816	      out[idx + 2] = b.to_byte()
1817	    }
1818	  }
1819	
1820	  @types.Image::{
1821	    width: w,
1822	    height: h,
1823	    channels: 3,
1824	    data: Bytes::from_array(out),	<-- UNCOVERED
1825	  }
1826	}
    	…

1832	pub fn decode_vp8_inter_frame(
1833	  data : Bytes,
1834	  offset : Int,
1835	  refs : Vp8ReferenceFrames,
1836	) -> (@types.Image, Vp8ReferenceFrames) raise @types.LoadError {
1837	  let br = Vp8BitReader::new(data, offset)	<-- UNCOVERED
1838	  let header = parse_vp8_frame_header(br)
1839	
1840	  if header.key_frame {
1841	    // 关键帧：使用常规解码并更新参考帧
1842	    let img = decode_vp8_frame(data, offset)	<-- UNCOVERED
1843	    // 将关键帧复制到参考帧
1844	    let w = img.width
1845	    let h = img.height
1846	    let y_size = w * h
1847	    let uv_size = w / 2 * (h / 2)
1848	    let new_refs = Vp8ReferenceFrames::new(w, h)	<-- UNCOVERED
1849	    // 从 RGB 转换回 YUV（简化：使用亮度作为 Y，UV 固定为 128）
1850	    for i in 0..<y_size {
1851	      let r = img.data[i * 3].to_int()	<-- UNCOVERED
1852	      let g = img.data[i * 3 + 1].to_int()
1853	      let b = img.data[i * 3 + 2].to_int()
1854	      let y = ((66 * r + 129 * g + 25 * b + 128) >> 8) + 16
1855	      new_refs.last_y[i] = y
1856	      new_refs.golden_y[i] = y
1857	      new_refs.altref_y[i] = y
1858	    }
1859	    for i in 0..<uv_size {
1860	      new_refs.last_u[i] = 128	<-- UNCOVERED
1861	      new_refs.last_v[i] = 128
1862	      new_refs.golden_u[i] = 128
1863	      new_refs.golden_v[i] = 128
1864	      new_refs.altref_u[i] = 128
1865	      new_refs.altref_v[i] = 128
1866	    }
1867	    return (img, new_refs)
1868	  }
1869	
1870	  // 非关键帧：使用帧间预测
1871	  let w = header.width
1872	  let h = header.height
1873	
1874	  if w == 0 || h == 0 {
1875	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("VP8 帧尺寸无效")	<-- UNCOVERED
1876	  }
1877	
1878	  // 解析量化参数
1879	  let quant = parse_quantization(br)	<-- UNCOVERED
1880	
1881	  let y_plane : Array[Int] = Array::make(w * h, 128)	<-- UNCOVERED
1882	  let u_plane : Array[Int] = Array::make(w / 2 * (h / 2), 128)
1883	  let v_plane : Array[Int] = Array::make(w / 2 * (h / 2), 128)
1884	
1885	  // 创建布尔解码器
1886	  let bd = Vp8BoolDecoder::new(data, offset + 10)	<-- UNCOVERED
1887	  let coeff_probs = Vp8AdaptiveProbs::new()
1888	  let mb_mode_probs = Vp8MbModeProbs::new()
1889	
1890	  // 运动向量预测缓存（用于相邻宏块的运动向量预测）
1891	  let mb_w = (w + 15) / 16
1892	  let mb_h = (h + 15) / 16
1893	  let mv_cache : Array[Vp8MotionVector] = Array::make(	<-- UNCOVERED
1894	    mb_w * mb_h,
1895	    Vp8MotionVector::new(),	<-- UNCOVERED
1896	  )
1897	
1898	  // 对每个宏块进行解码
1899	  for mb_y in 0..<mb_h {
1900	    for mb_x in 0..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
1901	      // 解析宏块类型（帧内/帧间/跳过）
1902	      let is_intra = bd.read_bool(180) == 1	<-- UNCOVERED
1903	
1904	      if is_intra {
1905	        // 帧内预测宏块
1906	        let above : Array[Int] = Array::make(16, 128)	<-- UNCOVERED
1907	        let left : Array[Int] = Array::make(16, 128)
1908	        let above_left = 128
1909	        let mode = vp8_parse_i16x16_mode(bd, mb_mode_probs)	<-- UNCOVERED
1910	        let uv_mode = vp8_parse_uv_mode(bd, mb_mode_probs)
1911	        ignore(uv_mode)
1912	        let pred = vp8_intra_predict_16x16(mode, above, left, above_left)
1913	
1914	        // 解析 DC 系数
1915	        let dc_coeffs = vp8_parse_dc_coeffs_16x16(bd, coeff_probs)	<-- UNCOVERED
1916	        let dc_residual = vp8_wht_4x4(dc_coeffs)
1917	
1918	        // 解析 AC 系数并进行 IDCT
1919	        for sub_y in 0..<4 {
1920	          for sub_x in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1921	            let ac_coeffs = vp8_parse_residual_4x4(bd, coeff_probs, false)
1922	            ac_coeffs[0] = ac_coeffs[0] + dc_residual[sub_y * 4 + sub_x]
1923	            let residual = vp8_idct_4x4(ac_coeffs)	<-- UNCOVERED
1924	            for y in 0..<4 {
1925	              for x in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
1926	                let px = mb_x * 16 + sub_x * 4 + x
1927	                let py = mb_y * 16 + sub_y * 4 + y
1928	                if px < w && py < h {
1929	                  let pred_y = sub_y * 4 + y	<-- UNCOVERED
1930	                  let pred_x = sub_x * 4 + x
1931	                  let mut val = pred[pred_y * 16 + pred_x] + residual[y * 4 + x]
1932	                  if val < 0 {
1933	                    val = 0	<-- UNCOVERED
1934	                  }
1935	                  if val > 255 {
1936	                    val = 255	<-- UNCOVERED
1937	                  }
1938	                  y_plane[py * w + px] = val
1939	                }
1940	              }
1941	            }
1942	          }
1943	        }
1944	      } else {
1945	        // 帧间预测宏块（运动补偿）
1946	        // 解析参考帧选择
1947	        let ref_frame = vp8_parse_ref_frame(bd, 200)	<-- UNCOVERED
1948	        let (ref_y, ref_u, ref_v) = vp8_get_ref_planes(refs, ref_frame)
1949	
1950	        // 运动向量预测（使用相邻宏块的中值）
1951	        let left_mv = if mb_x > 0 {
1952	          mv_cache[mb_y * mb_w + mb_x - 1]	<-- UNCOVERED
1953	        } else {
1954	          Vp8MotionVector::new()	<-- UNCOVERED
1955	        }
1956	        let above_mv = if mb_y > 0 {
1957	          mv_cache[(mb_y - 1) * mb_w + mb_x]	<-- UNCOVERED
1958	        } else {
1959	          Vp8MotionVector::new()	<-- UNCOVERED
1960	        }
1961	        let above_left_mv = if mb_x > 0 && mb_y > 0 {
1962	          mv_cache[(mb_y - 1) * mb_w + mb_x - 1]	<-- UNCOVERED
1963	        } else {
1964	          Vp8MotionVector::new()	<-- UNCOVERED
1965	        }
1966	        let pred_mv = vp8_predict_motion_vector(	<-- UNCOVERED

379	fn vp8_select_i16x16_mode(

470	      if i > 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
471	        // 检查是否是 EOB
472	        let mut has_nonzero = false	<-- UNCOVERED

475	            has_nonzero = true
476	            break
477	          }
478	        }
479	        if !has_nonzero {
480	          enc.encode_bool(1, 100) // EOB	<-- UNCOVERED
481	          eob = true
482	        } else {
483	          enc.encode_bool(0, 100) // 不是 EOB	<-- UNCOVERED
484	        }
485	      }
486	      enc.encode_bool(1, 200) // 零系数	<-- UNCOVERED
487	    } else {
488	      // 非零系数
489	      if i > 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
490	        enc.encode_bool(0, 100) // 不是 EOB
491	      }
492	      enc.encode_bool(0, 200) // 非零系数	<-- UNCOVERED
493	      // 编码值（简化：直接编码绝对值和符号）
494	      let abs_val = c.abs()	<-- UNCOVERED
495	      if abs_val == 1 {
496	        enc.encode_bool(1, 170) // 值为 1	<-- UNCOVERED
497	      } else {
498	        enc.encode_bool(0, 170) // 值大于 1	<-- UNCOVERED
499	        // 编码额外位（简化）
500	        let mut extra = abs_val - 1
501	        while extra > 0 {
502	          enc.encode_bit(1) // 继续	<-- UNCOVERED
503	          extra = extra >> 1
504	        }
505	        enc.encode_bit(0) // 结束	<-- UNCOVERED
506	      }
507	      // 符号位
508	      if c < 0 {
509	        enc.encode_bit(1)	<-- UNCOVERED
510	      } else {
511	        enc.encode_bit(0)	<-- UNCOVERED
512	      }
513	    }
514	  }
515	  if !eob {	<-- UNCOVERED
516	    // 没有 EOB，所有系数都非零
517	  }
518	}

535	fn vp8_enc_segment_params_new(
536	  y_plane : Array[Int],
537	  width : Int,
538	  height : Int,
539	  _base_quant : Int,
540	) -> Vp8EncSegmentParams {
541	  let mb_w = (width + 15) / 16	<-- UNCOVERED
542	  let mb_h = (height + 15) / 16
543	  let total_mbs = mb_w * mb_h
544	  let segment_id_map : Array[Int] = Array::make(total_mbs, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
545	  // 计算每个宏块的复杂度（方差）
546	  let complexities : Array[Int] = Array::make(total_mbs, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
547	  for mb_y in 0..<mb_h {
548	    for mb_x in 0..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
549	      let mut sum = 0
550	      let mut sum_sq = 0
551	      let mut count = 0
552	      for y in 0..<16 {
553	        for x in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
554	          let px = mb_x * 16 + x
555	          let py = mb_y * 16 + y
556	          if px < width && py < height {
557	            let val = y_plane[py * width + px]	<-- UNCOVERED
558	            sum += val
559	            sum_sq += val * val
560	            count += 1
561	          }
562	        }
563	      }
564	      if count > 0 {
565	        let mean = sum / count	<-- UNCOVERED
566	        let variance = sum_sq / count - mean * mean
567	        complexities[mb_y * mb_w + mb_x] = variance
568	      }
569	    }
570	  }
571	  // 根据复杂度分配 segment（0=低复杂度, 3=高复杂度）
572	  let mut max_complexity = 1
573	  for c in complexities {
574	    if c > max_complexity {	<-- UNCOVERED
575	      max_complexity = c
576	    }
577	  }
578	  for i in 0..<total_mbs {
579	    let ratio = complexities[i] * 4 / max_complexity	<-- UNCOVERED
580	    segment_id_map[i] = ratio.clamp(min=0, max=3)
581	  }
582	  // 量化器增量（高复杂度 segment 使用更小的量化增量，即更高质量）
583	  let quantizer_delta = [0, -4, -8, -12]
584	  Vp8EncSegmentParams::{
585	    segmentation_enabled: true,
586	    quantizer_delta,
587	    segment_id_map,
588	  }
589	}

593	fn vp8_enc_get_mb_quant(
594	  segment : Vp8EncSegmentParams,
595	  mb_x : Int,
596	  mb_y : Int,
597	  mb_w : Int,
598	  base_quant : Int,
599	) -> Int {
600	  if !segment.segmentation_enabled {	<-- UNCOVERED
601	    return base_quant
602	  }
603	  let idx = mb_y * mb_w + mb_x

605	    let seg_id = segment.segment_id_map[idx]
606	    let delta = segment.quantizer_delta[seg_id]
607	    return (base_quant + delta).clamp(min=1, max=127)	<-- UNCOVERED
608	  }
609	  base_quant

616	fn vp8_encoder_loop_filter(
617	  y_plane : Array[Int],
618	  width : Int,
619	  height : Int,
620	  filter_level : Int,
621	) -> Unit {
622	  if filter_level == 0 {	<-- UNCOVERED
623	    return
624	  }
625	  let mb_w = (width + 15) / 16
626	  let mb_h = (height + 15) / 16
627	  // 宏块边界垂直滤波
628	  for mb_y in 0..<mb_h {
629	    for mb_x in 1..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
630	      for y in 0..<16 {
631	        let py = mb_y * 16 + y
632	        if py >= height {
633	          break	<-- UNCOVERED
634	        }
635	        let px = mb_x * 16
636	        if px > 0 && px < width {
637	          let idx = py * width + px	<-- UNCOVERED
638	          let p1 = y_plane[idx - 1]
639	          let p0 = y_plane[idx]
640	          let diff = p0 - p1
641	          if diff.abs() < filter_level {	<-- UNCOVERED
642	            let adj = diff / 2
643	            y_plane[idx - 1] = p1 + adj
644	            y_plane[idx] = p0 - adj
645	          }
646	        }
647	      }
648	    }
649	  }
650	  // 宏块边界水平滤波
651	  for mb_y in 1..<mb_h {
652	    for mb_x in 0..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
653	      for x in 0..<16 {
654	        let px = mb_x * 16 + x
655	        if px >= width {
656	          break	<-- UNCOVERED
657	        }
658	        let py = mb_y * 16
659	        if py > 0 && py < height {
660	          let idx = py * width + px	<-- UNCOVERED
661	          let p1 = y_plane[idx - width]
662	          let p0 = y_plane[idx]
663	          let diff = p0 - p1
664	          if diff.abs() < filter_level {	<-- UNCOVERED
665	            let adj = diff / 2
666	            y_plane[idx - width] = p1 + adj
667	            y_plane[idx] = p0 - adj
668	          }
669	        }
670	      }
671	    }
672	  }
673	}

712	fn vp8_enc_adaptive_probs_update(probs : Vp8EncAdaptiveProbs) -> Unit {
713	  // 更新 token 概率
714	  for i in 0..<64 {	<-- UNCOVERED
715	    let count = probs.token_counts[i]
716	    if count > 0 {
717	      // EMA 更新：new_prob = old_prob * 0.875 + observed * 0.125
718	      let observed = (255 * count / (count + 1)).clamp(min=1, max=254)	<-- UNCOVERED
719	      probs.token_probs[i] = (probs.token_probs[i] * 7 + observed) / 8
720	      probs.token_counts[i] = 0
721	    }
722	  }
723	  // 更新预测模式概率
724	  let total = probs.pred_mode_counts[0] +
725	    probs.pred_mode_counts[1] +
726	    probs.pred_mode_counts[2] +
727	    probs.pred_mode_counts[3]
728	  if total > 0 {
729	    for i in 0..<4 {	<-- UNCOVERED
730	      let observed = (255 * probs.pred_mode_counts[i] / total).clamp(
731	        min=1,
732	        max=254,
733	      )
734	      probs.pred_mode_probs[i] = (probs.pred_mode_probs[i] * 7 + observed) / 8
735	      probs.pred_mode_counts[i] = 0
736	    }
737	  }
738	  probs.blocks_since_update = 0
739	}

847	pub fn encode_webp_lossy_full(
848	  img : @types.Image,
849	  quality? : Int = 75,
850	) -> Bytes raise @types.LoadError {
851	  let w = img.width	<-- UNCOVERED
852	  let h = img.height
853	  let ch = img.channels
854	  if w <= 0 || h <= 0 {
855	    raise @types.LoadError::EncodeFailed("WebP: 尺寸无效")	<-- UNCOVERED
856	  }
857	  if ch != 3 && ch != 4 {
858	    raise @types.LoadError::EncodeFailed("WebP: 仅支持 RGB/RGBA")	<-- UNCOVERED
859	  }
860	
861	  // 1. RGB → YUV420
862	  let (y_plane, u_plane, v_plane) = rgb_to_yuv420(img)	<-- UNCOVERED
863	
864	  // 2. 计算量化参数
865	  let quant = vp8_calc_quant_params(quality)	<-- UNCOVERED
866	
867	  // 3. 编码宏块

869	  let mb_h = (h + 15) / 16
870	  let enc = Vp8BoolEncoder::new()	<-- UNCOVERED
871	  // 自适应概率模型
872	  let adaptive_probs = vp8_enc_adaptive_probs_new()	<-- UNCOVERED
873	  // Segment 参数（基于图像复杂度自动分配）
874	  let segment = vp8_enc_segment_params_new(y_plane, w, h, quant.y_ac)	<-- UNCOVERED
875	  // 重建的 Y 平面（用于环路滤波和后续预测）
876	  let recon_y : Array[Int] = Array::make(w * h, 128)	<-- UNCOVERED
877	  for i in 0..<(w * h) {
878	    recon_y[i] = y_plane[i]	<-- UNCOVERED
879	  }
880	
881	  for mb_y in 0..<mb_h {
882	    for mb_x in 0..<mb_w {	<-- UNCOVERED
883	      // 选择最佳 I16x16 预测模式（基于 SAD 代价）
884	      let pred_mode = vp8_select_i16x16_mode(recon_y, mb_x, mb_y, w, h)	<-- UNCOVERED
885	      // 编码预测模式（使用自适应概率）
886	      let mode_idx = match pred_mode {	<-- UNCOVERED
887	        Vp8I16x16PredMode::I16x16DcPred => 0
888	        Vp8I16x16PredMode::I16x16TrueMotionPred => 1
889	        Vp8I16x16PredMode::I16x16HPred => 2
890	        Vp8I16x16PredMode::I16x16VPred => 3
891	      }
892	      // 使用自适应概率编码预测模式（简化：固定概率编码，记录统计）
893	      enc.encode_uint(mode_idx, 2)	<-- UNCOVERED
894	      vp8_enc_adaptive_probs_record_mode(adaptive_probs, mode_idx)
895	
896	      // 获取预测像素
897	      let pred = vp8_get_i16x16_prediction(pred_mode, recon_y, mb_x, mb_y, w, h)	<-- UNCOVERED
898	
899	      // 计算残差
900	      let residual : Array[Int] = Array::make(256, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED
901	      for y in 0..<16 {
902	        for x in 0..<16 {	<-- UNCOVERED
903	          let px = mb_x * 16 + x
904	          let py = mb_y * 16 + y
905	          if px < w && py < h {
906	            residual[y * 16 + x] = y_plane[py * w + px] - pred[y * 16 + x]	<-- UNCOVERED
907	          }
908	        }
909	      }
910	
911	      // 提取 16 个 4x4 子块的 DC 系数
912	      let dc_block : Array[Int] = Array::make(16, 0)	<-- UNCOVERED

918	              sum += residual[(sub_y * 4 + y) * 16 + (sub_x * 4 + x)]
919	            }

922	        }
923	      }

951	          // 编码
952	          vp8_encode_block_tokens(enc, quantized, false)	<-- UNCOVERED
953	        }
954	      }
955	      // 更新自适应概率模型（每 8 个宏块更新一次）
956	      adaptive_probs.blocks_since_update += 1
957	      if adaptive_probs.blocks_since_update >= adaptive_probs.update_interval {
958	        vp8_enc_adaptive_probs_update(adaptive_probs)	<-- UNCOVERED
959	      }
960	    }
961	  }
962	
963	  // 3.5 环路滤波（对重建的 Y 平面进行宏块边界滤波）
964	  let filter_level = (quant.y_ac / 4).clamp(min=0, max=63)	<-- UNCOVERED
965	  vp8_encoder_loop_filter(recon_y, w, h, filter_level)

968	  let token_data = enc.finish()	<-- UNCOVERED
969	
970	  // 5. 构建 VP8 frame header
971	  let header = vp8_build_frame_header(w, h, token_data.length())	<-- UNCOVERED
972	
973	  // 6. 合并 VP8 数据
974	  let vp8_data : Array[Byte] = []
975	  for i in 0..<header.length() {	<-- UNCOVERED
976	    vp8_data.push(header[i])
977	  }
978	  for i in 0..<token_data.length() {	<-- UNCOVERED
979	    vp8_data.push(token_data[i])
980	  }
981	
982	  // 7. 构建 WebP 容器
983	  let result = vp8_build_webp_container(w, h, Bytes::from_array(vp8_data))	<-- UNCOVERED
984	
985	  let _ = u_plane
986	  let _ = v_plane

988	}

132	pub fn zlib_inflate(data : Bytes) -> Bytes raise @types.LoadError {
133	  // 跳过 zlib 2 字节头 (CMF, FLG)
134	  if data.length() < 2 {
135	    raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("zlib 数据过短")
136	  }
137	  let reader = bit_reader_new(data)
138	  reader.pos = 2
139	  let output : Array[Byte] = []
140	  let mut done = false
141	  while !done {
142	    let bfinal = bit_reader_read_bits(reader, 1)
143	    let btype = bit_reader_read_bits(reader, 2)
144	    match btype {
145	      0 => {
146	        // Stored block: align to byte boundary
147	        reader.bit_buf = 0
148	        reader.bit_count = 0
149	        if reader.pos + 4 > reader.data.length() {
150	          raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
151	            "DEFLATE stored block 数据过短",
152	          )
153	        }
154	        let block_len = reader.data[reader.pos].to_int() |
155	          (reader.data[reader.pos + 1].to_int() << 8)
156	        reader.pos += 4
157	        if reader.pos + block_len > reader.data.length() {
158	          raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed(
159	            "DEFLATE stored block 数据越界",
160	          )
161	        }
162	        for i in 0..<block_len {
163	          output.push(reader.data[reader.pos + i])
164	        }
165	        reader.pos += block_len
166	      }
167	      1 => {
168	        // Fixed Huffman codes
169	        let (lit_tree, dist_tree) = build_fixed_trees()
170	        inflate_block_data(reader, output, lit_tree, dist_tree)
171	      }
172	      2 => {	<-- UNCOVERED
173	        // Dynamic Huffman codes
174	        let (lit_tree, dist_tree) = read_dynamic_trees(reader)	<-- UNCOVERED
175	        inflate_block_data(reader, output, lit_tree, dist_tree)
176	      }
177	      _ => raise @types.LoadError::DecodeFailed("DEFLATE 无效 block type")
178	    }
179	    if bfinal != 0 {
180	      done = true
181	    }
182	  }
183	  Bytes::from_array(output)

 83	fn interp_gradient(
 84	  v : Int,
 85	  stops : Array[(Int, Byte, Byte, Byte)],
 86	) -> (Byte, Byte, Byte) {
 87	  let len = stops.length()
 88	  if v <= stops[0].0 {
 89	    return (stops[0].1, stops[0].2, stops[0].3)
 90	  }
 91	  if v >= stops[len - 1].0 {
 92	    return (stops[len - 1].1, stops[len - 1].2, stops[len - 1].3)
 93	  }
 94	  for i in 0..<(len - 1) {
 95	    let (p0, r0, g0, b0) = stops[i]
 96	    let (p1, r1, g1, b1) = stops[i + 1]
 97	    if v >= p0 && v <= p1 {
 98	      let range = p1 - p0
 99	      if range == 0 {
100	        return (r0, g0, b0)	<-- UNCOVERED
101	      }
102	      let t = v - p0
103	      let r = r0.to_int() + (r1.to_int() - r0.to_int()) * t / range
104	      let g = g0.to_int() + (g1.to_int() - g0.to_int()) * t / range
105	      let b = b0.to_int() + (b1.to_int() - b0.to_int()) * t / range
106	      return (clamp_b(r), clamp_b(g), clamp_b(b))
107	    }
108	  }
109	  (b'\x00', b'\x00', b'\x00')
110	}

58	pub fn compute_stats_f(img : @types.ImageF) -> ImageStatsF {
59	  let n = img.width * img.height * img.channels
60	  let bpp = 4
61	  let mut sum = 0.0F
62	  let mut sum_sq = 0.0F
63	  let mut min_v = read_f32_le_s(img.data, 0)
64	  let mut max_v = min_v

66	    let v = read_f32_le_s(img.data, i * bpp)

68	    sum_sq += v * v

71	    }
72	    if v > max_v {
73	      max_v = v
74	    }
75	  }
76	  let n_f = Float::from_int(n)
77	  let mean = sum / n_f
78	  let variance = sum_sq / n_f - mean * mean
79	  let stddev = (if variance < 0.0F { 0.0F } else { variance }).sqrt()
80	  ImageStatsF::{ mean, stddev, min_val: min_v, max_val: max_v }
